description.zh: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Visual Basic 語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C或 JAVA程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the VB and C (or JAVA) programming languages will be introduced. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
syllabi.schedule:
Ｗeek 1-2 運算思維與程式設計 - 跨入程式設計的大門
程式設計，是針對電腦要解決的問題提供處理方式的過程，也是軟體開發時的重要步驟。Python是一個執行功能強大，但語法簡潔優雅的程式語言，不僅容易學習，更容易應用實作在許多專題上！

Ｗeek 3-5 變數與運算式 - 不只先乘除後加減
變數建立時，應用程式就會配置一塊記憶體，並以變數名稱做為辨識此塊記憶體的標誌，設計者就可在程式中將各種資料存入使用。運算式包含了運算元與運算子，可以進行程式的運算動作。
‧本章範例包括：成績單、稅率報表及薪資表格式化輸出\梯形、長方形面積計算\複利本金計算...等。

Week 6-8 判斷式 - 邏輯思維的起點
程式設計也和日常生活雷同，常會遇到一些需要做決策的情況，再依決策結果執行不同的程式碼，這就是「判斷式」。
‧本章範例包括：密碼比對判斷\輸入成績評等\電影分級判斷\百貨公司折扣戰\數字比大小...等。

Week 9 期中上機檢核

Week 10-11 迴圈 - 翻滾吧！程式碼
電腦最擅長處理的工作就是重複執行的事情，而日常生活中到處充斥著這種不斷重複的現象，程式專門用來處理重複事件的命令稱為「迴圈」。
‧本章範例包括：建立數列\計算正整數總和\井字直角三角形\九九乘法表\找最小公倍數\階乘計算...等。

Week 12-14  串列與元組 - 大量數據收納術
串列又稱為清單或列表，與其他語言的陣列相同，其功能與變數相類似，是提供儲存資料的記憶體空間。元組的結構與串列完全相同，不同處在於元組的元素個數及元素值皆不能改變。
‧本章範例包括：串列初值設定\迴圈讀取串列\成績計算\刪除串列元素\成績排序...等。

Week 15  字典 - 為資料貼上標籤
字典資料型態，其元素是以「鍵-值」對方式儲存，運作方式為利用「鍵」來取得「值」。‧本章範例包括：血型個性查詢\四季天氣查詢\成績查詢\產品銷售查詢\世大運獎牌數查詢...等。

Week 16 函式與模組 - 簡化運算擴充功能的利器
在程式中通常會將具有特定功能或經常重複使用的程式，撰寫成獨立的小單元，稱為函式。Python擁有許多模組，可讓功能可以無限擴充。
‧本章範例包括：攝氏華氏溫度\公斤英磅轉換\均分蘋果\電費、家庭支出查詢\網址格式檢查\檔案格式檢查\成績單、業績報表列印\日期時間格式轉換\擲骰子遊戲\大樂透抽獎\四星彩開獎...等。

Week 17  演算法：排序與搜尋 - 用邏輯來解決問題
演算法就是為了解決一個問題而採取的方法和步驟，通常會以虛擬碼來表示，再以熟悉的語言來實現。‧本章範例包括：數字排排站\追蹤泡沫排序\搜尋中獎者\彩券對獎...等。

Week 18 期末上機檢核

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原 理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺 陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物 理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度 、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course is a basic topics of Materials Science.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原 理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺 陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物 理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度 、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
This course is a basic topics of Materials Science.
syllabi.schedule:
Introduction to the course

The structure of crystalline solids
Crystal chemistry

Solid solutions and crystal defects
Mid term exam

Applications of electrical phenomea
Final exam

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en:
Physical,chemical,and molecular properties of materials commonly employed in civil engineering works.Influence of these properties on the performance and use of materials. 
Emphasis on laboratory evaluation of properties that control the performance of materials.

syllabi.outline:
本課程內容為介紹工程材料的基礎與應用，涵蓋工程材料的總述、材料物質之基本構成原理及各種土木工程使用材料的介紹。以理論、定義、性質、試驗及計標來教授學習者如何研究瞭解及鑑定選擇適用之材料，以達工程建設之品質要求。

The content of this course is to introduce the foundation and application of engineering materials, covering the general introduction of engineering materials, the basic principles of material composition and the introduction of various materials used in civil engineering. It teaches learners how to research, understand and identify suitable materials to meet the quality requirements of engineering construction with theory, definition, properties, experiments and standard calculation.

syllabi.outline:
1. 首先在訓練學生基本數學思惟及推理的能力，另外也銜接基礎數學及微積分的課程，以奠定各專業領域所需的數學基礎。 
2. 課程內容以教導學生具有分析處理實際工程問題所需之基本數學觀念及能力為主。 
3. 強調理論基礎、運算技巧及實際應用領域，另特別增強解題技巧及演算能力，使對將來繼續深造能預作準備。 
4. 使學生具備未來成為頂尖工程師或科學家所需要之入門工具。
5. 本學期課程以常微分方程為主

18週: 期末考

description.zh:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解設計圖中內容，本課程採用實務的教學方式，以工程師實際面對的建築設計圖、結構設計圖、土木設計圖及機電設計圖等，加以解說圖面內容並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下:
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容
2.熟悉設計圖上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義
3.結構標準圖、配筋圖與施工規範之解說
4.如何依設計圖進行工程品質之查驗
5.其他與勞工安全相關知識等
description.en:
To improve undergraduate civil engineering students to understand the design drawings reading ability.  This course provides a set of design drawings, such as building, structural, civil and MEP design drawings, for instructors to explain the meaning of the design drawing, and guide the students to read the related drawings. The course also includes practical exercise for students to read the drawings, and to understand the information in the drawings. The course will also involves the knowledge of engineering to enhance the integration ability of all the design drawings for the students. The contents of this  course are listed as below:
1.To familiar with the whole set design drawings.
2.To familiar with the meaning of symbols, lines and expression in the design drawings.
3.To understand general notes, general drawings, reinforcement and specification in structural design drawings.
4.How to inspect the construction quality by the design drawings.
5.Other topics about labor-safety

syllabi.outline:
為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解建築工程中設計圖、結構圖、施工圖說及營造工程施工圖說之內容與應用。本課程採用實務的教學方式，以營造工程師實際面對的建築設計圖說、結構設計圖說及機電設計圖說...等內容。加以解說圖面內容，並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下: 
1.熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容。 
2.熟悉施工圖說上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義。 
3.結構構造之標準圖、配筋圖、鋼構...與施工規範之解說。
4.BIM基本建置原則與實務管理模型知識。 
5.如何依設計圖說進行工程品質之查驗。 
6.其他與工程實務所需之知識與技能、施工、構造、勞工安全...等，相關法令知識與其專業領域結合。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋兩部分：(1)介紹一階常微分方程式，二階與高階的線性微分方程式，包含物理問題或是其他問題導出微分方程式，以實際重要性的簡單方法求解答。(2)線性代數，矩陣、向量、行列式、線性方程式組，應用於電路與力學之最佳化計算過程。
description.en: This course includes two main parts: (1) Introduction of first-order ordinary differential equations, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, including physics problems or other problems to derive differential equations, and solve them in a practical importance simple method. (2) Linear algebra, matrix, vector, determinant and linear equations can be applied in the optimized calculation process of circuits and mechanics.

name.en: Textile materials and principles of textile Technology

description.zh:
1. 本課程主要說明各種紡織材料之組成和成形, 基本性質, 各種加工與應用。 
2. 本課程主要簡介紡織科技所包含之原料與製程, 製品和評估，同時訓練學生了解基本的紡織辭彙。
description.en:
1. Introduction to textile compositions, properties, spinning, processings and applications. 
2. Textile materials and related processes are introduced, and technical used are learned as well.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要是教授紡織上的基本概念，對於整體紡織從原料到成紗、織布、染色、整理加工及成衣與行銷貿易等皆有普遍性認識，以建立未來學習紡織專業知識的良好基礎。上學期其主要內容為討論紡織原料的種類與製造方法及各種纖維之特性及適用性，其中包括天然纖維諸如棉、毛、絲、麻等，以及人造纖維諸如再生纖維（嫘縈），半合成纖維（醋酸纖維）與合成纖維（尼龍、聚酯、聚丙烯晴、聚烯烴及其他工業用纖維等）。有關上述纖維之化學性質與物理特性皆在課程中詳加說明介紹，並針對纖維物性之差異性從微細構造方面予以簡單闡述解說，以建立將來相關課程之基礎。
This course mainly teaches the basic concepts of textiles for a general understanding of the overall textile from raw materials to yarn, weaving, dyeing, finishing, clothing and marketing trade, etc., to establish the future of learning professional textile knowledge. The main content of the last semester was to discuss the types and manufacturing methods of textile materials and the characteristics and applicability of various fibers, including natural fibers such as cotton, wool, silk, hemp, etc., and man-made fibers such as regenerated fibers (rayon), semi-synthetic fiber (acetate fiber) and synthetic fibers (nylon, polyester, polyacrylonitrile, polyolefin, and other industrial fibers, etc.). The chemical properties and physical properties of the fibers mentioned above are explained in detail in the course. The differences in the fibers' physical properties are briefly described in terms of the microstructure to establish future related studies.

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法(TPD)及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD.  From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

syllabi.outline: The course introduces fundamentals of surface property and various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD. From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹一系列的生物大分子及構成這些生物分子的基本分子。課程從認識細菌、植物、動物細胞及各種細胞胞器開始，接著探討蛋白質、酵素、DNA、RNA、脂質、糖類結構和功能及他們在生命中的重要性。構成蛋白質的二十種氨基酸和組成DNA或RNA的四個核甘酸及構成脂質、糖類結構的生物分子將詳細被探討。
description.en: This course is to introduce a serials of biomaterials and their functions. Begins from bacterial, plant, and animal cells and the differences between these cell organs. To learn of DNA, RNA, proteins, and enzymes base on their structures and functions. The characters of 20 amino acids and 4 nucleotides will be studied in detail. Carbohydrates and lipids are learned by their specific functions.

description.en: Inorganic chemistry is one of the three frames of chemistry. Various materials in our daily life are composed of inorganic materials. This course will be given in a manner of easy-getting-point. The contents comprise of chemistry of main group elements and transition elements. The course covers the following topics: (1) Survey of principles (2) Chemistry of main group elements (A. Boron; B. Group 1, 2, 15, 16, 17 Elements) (3) Chemistry of transition elements (A. Survey of Transition Elements; B. Elements of the first transition series; C. Titanium, Chromium, Cobalt, Nickel and Copper (4) Atomic Structure (5) Simple Bonding Theory (6) Symmetry, Vibration Application and Group Theory (7) Molecular Orbitals and (8) Acid-Base and Donor-Acceptor Chemistry.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 1.瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件 (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等 (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應 (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域 (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。2.瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路 (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析 (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換 (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數 (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用 (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

Kirchhoff laws, 4. Thevenin and Norton theorem, 5. First and second order circuit, 6. Node and loop analysis, 7. Steady state response and analysis, 8. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。

description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程講授家具工程製圖技術及相關知識，著重在家具工程製圖與一般工程製圖的主要差別，其能讓學生將所設計的家具產品以圖面表達其細部結構與工程要件。
description.en:
This is the lecture of furniture engineering drawing technique and related knowledge, It emphases on the main difference between furniture engineering drawing and normal engineering drawing. The aim is for students to present the
detailed construction and main parts of their furniture design product by drawing.

description.zh:
行銷是由物品的流通及製造者對消費者或使用者所提供之服務等商業
活動所構成的。包括產品、產銷地點、通路及價格等四個主要原理。
行銷研究是幫助經營者去發展及研究市場並研擬更好之行銷計劃，包
括四種主要活動：研究計劃、收集情報、分析及發表。
description.en: This course aims to provide the student with knowledge of marketing, including product strategy, physical distribution, channel and pricing. Case study and discuss through activities (planning, investigation, analysis and presentation) that carry out strategic marketing are employed from time to time.

syllabi.outline:
本課程使同學未來在產品設計領域中，能融入所學行銷知識與技術，以填補產品設計與顧客需求之間的缺口。讓同學能一窺自己每天消費生活的各個巨微層面，期望每一同學都可經由自己消費生活的體驗而激發創意靈感，進而提升自己的設計品質，使產品設計更具「市場驅動」或「顧客導向」的意涵。
本課程以講授行銷學相關理論在產品設計上的應用為主。
1.以釋例說明來凸顯理論的實用性。
2.提供同學目前或未來在從事產品設計或行銷管理工作時，所必須具備的行銷知識和實用「工具箱」。

（利用腦力激盪方式，帶領同學「回到原點」思考問題）

syllabi.outline: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新之思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。

description.en: In the design and manufacturing of a product is is essential that the machine as wellas the process be understood, Manufacturing requires tools and machines that can produce products economically as well as accurately. This course serves as an introduction to various manufacturing, foundry, special casting, and special working process.

syllabi.outline:
課程摘要
主題一：仿生家具與燈具設計 (一人一組：1 家具)  或  (兩人一組：系列家具)

111-1 家具設計包含了(1)仿生設計專題及(2)機能模組化家具專題，為連貫18周課程，可先上網了解這些內容，以利操作可以更加流暢。

仿生練習
1.請針對以下類別分組如下：
2.A昆蟲、B陸花、C陸動物、D海動物、E海生物、F空生物共6大主題，一個主題最多5-6人挑選一主題，觀察形體與構成，針對其不同姿態與各側面向一人畫 20~30 張具多元性之精緻草圖。
※ 註解: 草圖並非只是單純畫的很精細，而是畫的過程中，要思考如何擷取出具代表性的造型特徵，跟紋理表現，利用點、線、面構成，賦予色彩，色塊去表現。嘗試從正視圖、側視圖、上視圖各角度去描繪跟觀察。
※ 選定生物雲端連結調查: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ettKgmlhHObUEFAEuDRRA-O01-QuZ0xU?usp=sharing
3. 蒐集此主題目前已被應用之仿生設計(至少5例)，分析案例造型與機能之間的 
   關聯性。
4. 先開始嘗試利用點、線、面解構及分解造型與特徵，開學會比較輕鬆。
5. 開學第一周會進行簡報，說明選定主題(選定動植物)，展示已繪製草圖，及        
   找到的仿生案例5例，並說明分析該案例在仿生造型與機能之間的關聯性。
6. 主要訓練目的是造型特徵掌握與質感的拿捏，搭配機能與人因的考量。

教學單元
第一步:  挑選有形的有機生物(包含動植物) 。
第二步:  精細(1)描繪全身草圖 -- > 逐步簡化成(2)局部部位特寫及(3)特徵結構體。
第三步:  解構造型的比例，結構，質感及特徵。
第四步:  對應家具產品機能，操作性及造型語意。
第五步:  擷取紋理，色彩，及符碼。
第六步:  考量使用性，機能性，人性因素需求

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:
1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。
2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。
3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。
4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。
5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。
This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. First year - An introduction to basic design problem solving : concepts of point, line, plane, and space organization : principles of unity/variety ,order ,balance , proportion ,scale , etc.; orthographic projection and axonometrics ; pattern diagramming ; and basic design consequences of human activity. 
The course as the fundamental of architectural design aims to foster basic knowledge from the perspective of architectural aesthetics, experience, and design execution. Combined with the lateral curriculum of construction, drawing, design theory, and housing renewal projects, the program built upon diversified exposures in 1. aesthetics, 2. architectural drawings and rendering techniques, 3. spatial constructs and logics, 4.  Professional training, 5.  materials and experiments, 6. communication and presentation.

syllabi.outline: 本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年----主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年----主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。第三學年----主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年----主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年----主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。第三學年----主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:
1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。
2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。
3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。
4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。
5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。
This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. First year - An introduction to basic design problem solving : concepts of point, line, plane, and space organization : principles of unity/variety ,order ,balance , proportion ,scale , etc.; orthographic projection and axonometrics ; pattern diagramming ; and basic design consequences of human activity. 
The course as the fundamental of architectural design aims to foster basic knowledge from the perspective of architectural aesthetics, experience, and design execution. Combined with the lateral curriculum of construction, drawing, design theory, and housing renewal projects, the program built upon diversified exposures in 1. aesthetics, 2. architectural drawings and rendering techniques, 3. spatial constructs and logics, 4.  Professional training, 5.  materials and experiments, 6. communication and presentation.

description.zh:
本課程主要教導學生認識建築物理環境之基本理論，包含光環境、溫熱環境、空氣環境、音環境等，做為學習建築環境控制系統與建築設備之基礎。本課程內容分為七大部分，包括(一)建築氣象學概論、(二)建築微氣候環境、(三)建築採光與照明、(四)建築傳熱與隔熱、(五)室內通風換氣、(六)濕氣與結露、(七) 隔音與吸音等課題。
本學期介紹物理環境基本學理外，同時輔以相關案例補充說明，幫助學生在建築設計中能關注到使用者舒適、健康需求，並使其建築設計符合節能的永續建築要求。
description.en:
In this course, students will learn about the fundamental theories of architecture physics which include luminous environment, thermal environment, air environment, and sound environment as an introduction to understanding Systems of Environment Control and Architectural Equipment. The course is divided into 7 sections, (1) Introduction to Architecture Meteorology, (2) Architecture Microclimate, (3) Natural Lighting and Illumination of architecture, (4) Thermal Conduction and Proofing of Architecture, (5) Indoor Air Change and Ventilation, (6) Humidity and Condensation, and  (7) Sound absorption and proofing.
  In this semester, other than introducing the fundamental theories, related case studies are also incorporated as additional support to help students to be attentive toward issues such as comfort and health in their architectural design class at the same time to encourage the utilization of such knowledge to create energy saving and sustainable architectural designs.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要教導學生認識建築物理環境之基本理論，包含光環境、溫熱環境、空氣環境、音環境等，做為學習建築環境控制系統與建築設備之基礎。本課程內容分為七大部分，包括(一)建築氣象學概論、(二)建築微氣候環境、(三)室內通風換氣、(四)濕氣與結露、(五)建築採光與照明、(六)建築傳熱與隔熱、(七) 隔音與吸音等課題。
本學期介紹物理環境基本學理外，同時輔以相關案例補充說明，幫助學生在建築設計中能關注到使用者舒適、健康需求，並使其建築設計符合節能的永續建築要求。
In this course, students will learn about the fundamental theories of architecture physics which include luminous environment, thermal environment, air environment, and sound environment as an introduction to understanding Systems of Environment Control and Architectural Equipment. The course is divided into 7 sections, (1) Introduction to Architecture Meteorology, (2) Architecture Microclimate, (3) Natural Lighting and Illumination of architecture, (4) Thermal Conduction and Proofing of Architecture, (5) Indoor Air Change and Ventilation, (6) Humidity and Condensation, and  (7) Sound absorption and proofing.
  In this semester, other than introducing the fundamental theories, related case studies are also incorporated as additional support to help students to be attentive toward issues such as comfort and health in their architectural design class at the same time to encourage the utilization of such knowledge to create energy saving and sustainable architectural designs.

description.zh:
現代主義運動，帶動了新建築的發展，也致使廿世紀的建築有了全新的可能。工業革命之後所帶動的，不僅僅是生產與製造的工業化，也不僅僅是資本的集中以及資本量的大幅成長。整個十九世紀的發展都是為了邁向一個全新的紀元，營建材料的開發、營建技術的發展、空間概念的突破，開創新的建築面貌以及新的建築歷史。
這個將近兩百年的建築發展，影響了廿世紀的建築教育，並且提供養分，供給新的世代的建築新發展。本課程將就十九、廿世紀的建築發展的歷史脈絡進行梳理，學生將由本課程理解今日其所進行的建築設計之來源。
description.en:
The Modern Movement of Architecture leads the development of new architecture, it thus deduce a whole new possibility of architecture. The Industrial Revolution is the motor of the whole movement. The building construction is industrialized under this overall influence to the society, not only on the concentration of capitals. The social life has been changed. Nineteenth Century is a struggling period with European tradition, moving forward to a new imagination, on the development of construction material, technics, also on the breakthrough on the spatial concept.

This evolution on architecture influences architectural education of 20th Century, and feeds the new creation of architecture. This course is to understand this historic evolution and context, to understand the source and establish knowledge in face of their future architectural activities.

description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. description.en: Instructing the basis of computer engineering drawing, including the concepts of orthographic projection of 3D space and the methods of geometry graphics. Training the skills to raw sketch, various 3D views. Learning to mark dimensions, tolerance and fittings correctly. This lesson also demands students to able to be familiarized the drawings of steel structures, hydraulic and fluid systems, and related mechanical devices.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱：
以套裝軟體學習電腦輔助繪圖，及如何將此技術應用於冷凍空調領域。本學期進行主題包括建築圖說、空調設備、相關閥件、控制圖等，透過實際操作演練培養對空調設計圖說之識圖與繪製等技能，並從學習過程中奠定空調領域之專業能力與拓展工程領域之文化與知識。
課程目標與學習成效：
1.	具備產業常用工程製圖軟體基本操作能力。
2.	具備空調圖說辨識與繪製能力。
3.	具備空調系統架構辨識與繪製能力。

description.zh: (1)基本電路元件介紹; (2)基本電路理論回顧; (3)半導體特性介紹; (4)半導體二極體電路分析技巧; (5)半導體二極體之應用:整流器,濾波器,剪波器,箝位器,倍壓器; (6)其他特殊二極體:發光二極體,齊納二極體,…; (7)雙極接合面電晶體工作原理; (8)雙極接合面電晶體直流偏壓電路; (9)雙極接合面電晶體交流小信號電路分析; (10)場效電晶體之分類:接合面型,金氧半增強型,金氧半衰減型,金氧半垂直型,金氧半互補型; (11)場效電晶體工作原理; (12)場效電晶體直流偏壓電路; (13)場效電晶體交流小信號電路分析
description.en: (1) Introduction to basic circuit components; (2)The review of basic circuit theories; (3)Introduction to the characteristics of semiconductors; (4)Circuit analysis techniques for semiconductor PN diode; (5)The applications of PN diode: Rectifier, Filter, Clipper, Clamper, and Voltage-doubler; (6)Special diodes: Light emitting diode(LED), Zener diode, etc.; (7)The operation principles of bipolar junction transistor(BJT); (8)DC biasing circuits for BJTs; (9)Small signal analysis for BJT circuits; (10)The classification of field effect transistor(FET): JFET, Enhancement-MOS, Depletion-MOS, VMOS, and CMOS; (11)The operation principles of FET; (12)DC bias circuits for FETs; (13)Small signal analysis for FET circuits

syllabi.outline: 本課程是電子學初級課程。主要重點在教授電子學基礎知識，並強調以實務練習及範例設計為主的方式。本課程介紹類比電路設計最重要的觀念，包含半導體二極體、電晶體，以及各種放大器組態等，另外也包含頻率響應、差動對、多級放大器等相關重點。

syllabi.outline: This course aims to enhance students’ speaking skills with a particular focus on listening comprehension, critical analysis of certain issues, organization of ideas, and lucid delivery of a speech. The course is designed thematically and divided into 7 teaching sections. Each section contains two weeks. In the first week, we will approach a specific issue by watching an introductory video clip, doing listening exercises and understanding key terms. And then students will be divided into groups to discuss and present their opinions regarding the issue. In the second week, we will further explore the issue by watching selected scenes from a relevant film. Each group will be asked to answer critical questions by analyzing the scenes, formulate and organize their ideas, and deliver a short speech at the end of the class.

description.zh: 本科目旨在探討現實世界裡語言和溝通的種種現象，如：社會中之語言變化、大眾媒體的語言使用等，並介紹應用語言學門之緣起和現況。學生將需要分享自己對於本地或國際有關語言應用議題的觀察，例如：職場溝通模式、辨識性言詞分析、語言教學/測試趨勢、口筆翻譯項目、語言在新型媒體中之應用等。
description.en: This course aims to explore a variety of phenomena in language and communication in the real world, e.g., language variations in societies, language in the mass media, etc. It will also provide an overview of the historical background and the existing profile of applied linguistics as an academic discipline. Students are expected to share their own observations on AL-related issues, e.g., workplace communication modes, critical discourse analysis, language instruction/testing trends, translation/ interpretation projects, language use in the new forms of media, etc., in the local or international context.

syllabi.outline:
本堂課會探討幾個語言學子領域以及跨語言學、行為科學和社會科學之基礎課題：語言習得、社會語言學、心理語言學、計算機語言學等。學生將學習以實驗性的方法搜集資料、來探討他們選擇的語言現象。
本堂課理論實務介紹會穿插著學生實體或線上實驗、練習操作。

This course will explore a variety of disciplines within linguistics as well as some cross-interdisciplinary linguistic domains. Students will learn to use experimental methods to collect data to investigate the language phenomenon of their choice. Class lectures will be intertwined with hands-on experiments (online or offline) and activities during the 3-hour meeting.

syllabi.outline: 本課程使學生具有基礎西班牙語能力，並加強會話及閱讀能力訓練。
syllabi.schedule:
第一~三週: 發音及練習。
第四週: 發音測驗。Ser及llamarse在第一至第三單數人稱的動詞變化及句型練習。
第五週: 問候及介紹其他人，國籍形容詞，數字1~10。
第六週: Ser的第一至第三複數人稱的動詞變化及句型練習，Este 和esta的區別。
第七週: 問人職業，數字11~20，問人手機號碼及電子信箱。
第八週: 以ar結尾的動詞之直述法現在式變化，考前複習。
第九週: 期中考
第十週: 試卷檢討。 Estar的動詞變化，estar與ser的用法區別。
第十一週: 介紹家人及自己，名詞單、複數。
第十二週: 表示「位置」的用詞，所有格形容詞。
第十三週: 以er結尾的動詞之直述法現在式變化，「幾點了?」--- 問&回答。
第十四週: 數字21~100，以ir結尾的動詞之直述法現在式變化。
第十五週: 指示代名詞 este / estos、esta / estas，以規則動詞trabajar, comer和 vivir及不規則動詞ser和 tener做句型練習 。    
第十六週: 反身動詞的用法，談每日例行生活。
第十七週: 今天是星期幾? --- 問&回答，考前複習。 
第十八週: 期末考

附註: 1) 以上規劃之課程內容會依學生學習狀況適時調整。 
       2) 每週均會在課中導入文化認知。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述統計學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋三個領域：敘述統計、機率理論與推論統計，其中包含概念介紹、敘述統計、機率理論、推論統計。另有統計學的應用領域於推論未知的情況以作為相關決策之依據，並包含統計軟體使用介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Statistics is to give students an introductory of statistical thinking, methods development and the assessment of credibility and value of inferences made from data.  A conceptual introduction to the field of statistics and its many applications with extensive coverage of data collection and analysis as needed to evaluate the reported results of statistical students and make a good decision will be included as well. The statistical software introduction will also be introduced in the class.

description.zh: 本課程適合一般大專行銷管理之授課。其目的在尋求優良的產品行銷管理方法，以求企業之良好利潤。本課程授課內容在使學生瞭解行銷管理之觀念，產品設計、產品運銷、促銷及訂價。相關之授課內容包括：市場區隔、市場組織、購買行為、產品開發、零售、批發、促銷、廣告及訂價程序等。
description.en: The marketing course is suitable to college student. The purpose is to find good method of product marketing, in order to pursuit good profit of enterprise. The related course includes: market segmentation, market organization, the behavior of buying, product development, retailing, whole-saling promotion, advertising and price setting process.

description.zh: 資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。本課程方向包括：資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：以MS SQL Server為例，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計開發之能力。
description.en: The objective of this course is to study the techniques of how to design and manage a database system. The topics contained in this course are: database system structure, relational database, E-R model, relational database design, query optimization, relational database management system-MS SQL Server etc. After studying this course, students should be able to design databases and manage database systems.

syllabi.outline:
資料庫系統與應用課程的目的在研習資料庫設計與管理技術及其在企業的應用。課程包括兩部分，第一部分介紹資料庫系統：包括資料庫管理系統架構、關聯式資料模式、關聯式資料庫設計理論、關聯查詢最佳化、關聯式資料庫管理系統：
第二部分介紹Power BI 資料庫數據分析以及視覺化工具的操作以及使用，以實務性方式，培養學生對資料庫系統設計及數據分析的能力。
The purpose of the database system and application courses is to study database design and management technology and its application in enterprises. The course consists of two parts. The first part introduces the database system: including the database management system architecture, relational data model, relational database design theory, relational query optimization, and relational database management system:
The second part introduces the operation and use of Power BI database data analysis and visualization tools, in a practical way, to train students to the database system design and data analysis ability.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)﹐內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力,亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This curriculum enters the step curriculum for the financial accounting. Intermediate accounting requires ever increasing knowledge and refinement of skills. Our goal is to achieve the most educational effective blend of concepts and practice relation to the current intermediate accounting body of knowledge. This course strives to provide the material needed to understand this subject area using IFRS. It may also be helpful to participate in accountant the license test and the government workers examination.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 線性代數為科學與工程的基礎數學工具，本課程教授線性代數的基本概念與運算技巧。課程大綱如下：1.線性聯立方程組 2.矩陣 3.行列式 4.二維與三維向量 5.向量空間 6.線性轉換 7.特徵值及特徵向量
description.en: Linear algebra is a fundamental mathematics course in science and engineering. In this course, the basic concepts and computation skills of linear algebra will be covered. The course includes the following topics: 1.Systems of linear Equations 2.Matrices 3.Determinants 4.Vectors in R2 and R3 5.Vector spaces 6.Linear transformations 7.Eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

syllabi.outline:
線性代數為科學與工程的基礎數學工具，本課程教授線性代數的基本概念與運算技巧。課程大綱包括：矩陣、線性聯立方程組、線性轉換、向量空間、特徵值及特徵向量、正交性與最小平方估計。
This course Linear Algebra
- is a mathematics course.
- is useful and fundamental to CSIE (and many other discipline) students.
- emphasizes both computations and concepts.
- asks you to use mathematical software packages (MATLAB, Scilab, or GNU Octave).
- guides you to read an English textbook.
- requires hard work.
本課程
- 為數學課
- 為資工領域(及許多其他專業領域)學生基礎課程
- 計算與概念並重
- 要求使用MATLAB, Scilab, 或 GNU Octave等套裝軟體
- 引導同學閱讀英文教科書
- 需要同學用功讀書
syllabi.schedule:
課程資料將透過北科i學園+、FB、Teams、或Zuvio公布。
課程進度：
1. Matrix Operations (Sections 2.1 and 2.2) 矩陣運算
- To learn basic matrix arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication power, transpose, and inverse. 矩陣加、減、乘、乘方、轉置、反矩陣
2. Linear Equations (Sections 1.1 to 1.5) 線性方程式
- To understand the basic terminologies and notations of matrices and systems of linear equations, in the forms of vector equation and matrix equation. 線性聯立方程組、向量方程式、矩陣方程式
- Solving a system of linear equations by reducing a matrix to its echelon form. 解線性聯立方程組、階梯型式
Test #1
3. Introduction to Linear Independence and Linear Transformation (Sections 1.7, 1.8, and 2.3) 線性獨立與線性轉換
- First exposure to key concepts such as linear independence and linear transformation. 線性獨立與線性轉換初探
- More about the matrix inverse. 更多有關反矩陣
- To summarize the concepts for systems of n linear equations in n unknowns. 綜整n個變數n個線性方程式
Midterm Exam
3. Vector Spaces (Chapter 4) 向量空間
- Introduction to vector spaces. 向量空間簡介
- Fundamental subspaces of a matrix: column space, row space, and null space. 矩陣子空間：行空間、列空間、零空間
- Basis, coordinate system and dimension. 基底、座標系統和維度
Test #2
4. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors (Chapter 5) 特徵值與特徵向量
- To understand the meaning of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, and the approaches to find them. 矩陣特徵值與特徵向量的意義與計算方式
- Diagonalization of a matrix (linear transformation). 矩陣的對角化
5.  Orthogonality and Least Squares (Chapter 6) 正交性與最小平方
- To introduce inner product of vectors, and thus the geometric concepts of length, distance, and angle (perpendicularity). 向量內積，長度、距離、角度(垂直)
- To be familiar with the use of orthogonal bases. 正交基底
- Least-Squares approximation. 最小平方估計
Final Exam

description.zh: 本課程介紹ARM CPU 及以ARM CPU為核心之微算機系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，SRAM、DRAM、及Flash Memory之介紹，時序圖之閱讀，記憶體及I/O解碼，串列I/O及並列I/O之介紹，計時及計數器之使用，震盪器介紹，A/D及D/A轉換，中斷之使用，及應用實例之介紹。
description.en: This course covers the following topics: introduction to ARM CPU, instruction set of ARM CPU, introduction to DRAM, SRAM and Flash memory, reading of timing diagrams, decoding of memory and I/O, parallel and serial ports, using timers and counters, oscillators, A/D and D/A converters, interrupts, and case study.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電路基本元件與電路之分析方法，內容包含： 1.基本電路元件：電壓源、電流源、電阻器、電容器、電感器 2.柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律，簡單電阻電路，節點分析與網目分析 3.電路學定理：重疊定理、戴維寧與諾頓定理 4.一階電路 5.二階電路 6.弦波穩態分析 7.頻率響應 8.雙埠電路

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 即使科學昌明如此，但我們日常生活中使用的、不斷推陳出新的照相機、攝錄影機、影印機等，在在都說明幾何光學現在仍然是主宰設計的工具。光學主要是藉著對光本質方面的瞭解，發展有關的理論基礎與計算法則，並進而用在日常生活且增益人類福祉的一門科學。幾何光學則是光學理論中，一連串近似運算的結果，著重在成像的效果和應用的一門工具性知識。本系之幾何光學是一學期、三學分、每週三小時的課程，教學內容大致包含以下三部份：一、介紹光的性質、在介面上反射、折射之有關定理、成像的原因及應用。二、分析像差現象及其成因與評估。三、淺介透鏡之設計。
description.en: Light is the principal means by which we gain knowledge of the world. From putting continually the improved camera, video cassette recorder, copying machine, etc., to market can just account for how important a designing tool the Geometric-Optics is.To build a solid basic theory and a rule for calculating through understanding thoroughly the nature of light is the central goal of Optics. Using the basic theory of optics and processes of approximate estimate, the Geometric-Optics put its point on image formation and its applications.Here in our department, the Geometric-Optics is a 3-credit, 3-hour per week, one-semester course. There are three consecutives parts in the one-semester lecture:The 1st part : (a)the nature of light, (b)the related theorems about reflection and refraction, (c) image formation.The 2nd part : the formation and correctness of aberrations.The 3rd part : the designing of lenses.

syllabi.outline:
電路學主要是介紹「電源」、「電阻」、「電晶體」、「電容」、「電感」等基本電子元件的組合應用， 分成提供電力的主動式元件「電壓源」與「電流源」，還有消耗電力的被動式元件「電阻」，所組成的電路可簡單分成 由「電源」、「電阻」、「電晶體」所組成的「靜態電路」與 由「電源」、「電容」、「電感」所組成的「動態電路」。 電子在電路中的流動行為與物體質量的流動行為相似，電路中的克希霍夫電流定律(KCL)等同於物體質量流動的連續方程， 也就是「電荷守恆定律」及「質量守恆定律」；電路中的克希霍夫電壓定律(KVL)等同於物體質量受重力或守恆力(Conservative Forces) 作用下的位能變化。
Circuits mainly introduces the combined application of basic electronic components such as "power", "resistance", "transistor", "capacitor", "inductance" and so on. It is divided into the active components "voltage source" and "current source" that provide power. There is also a passive component "resistor" that consumes power. The circuit formed can be simply divided into a "static circuit" consisting of "power", "resistance", and "transistor" and a "power", "capacitor", and "inductance". "Dynamic circuit" composed of. The flow behavior of electrons in the circuit is similar to the flow behavior of the mass of an object. The Kirchhoff current law (KCL) in the circuit is equivalent to the continuous equation of the mass flow of an object, that is, the "law of conservation of charge" and "the law of conservation of mass"; The Kirchhoff voltage law (KVL) in the circuit is equivalent to the potential energy change of the mass of an object under the action of gravity or conservation forces (Conservative Forces).

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

characteristics and applications are described.

The course of the electronics experiment laboratory teaches testing and designing of analog circuits. The course will introduce basic instrumentation instructions and understanding of electronic parts, including diode circuits (characteristics), transistor circuits (characteristics), linear voltage regulators and filters, and electronics applications. The course introduces the principle of electronics, the simulation of the circuit, and practical verification of circuits with project learning-based teaching methods.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 文化專題（一）課程培養同學認識臺灣不同族群的生活文化，介紹各領域與各時期的文化特色，包括：原住民各族文化、荷西鄭氏時期的多元文化、農業移墾文化、日治臺灣的近代文化、臺灣近代社會變遷、當代文藝發展與變遷、大眾文化與全球化。
description.en: This course is designed to cultivate the students' understanding of life culture from different groups in Taiwan. Students will learn the introduction of cultural feature from each areas and periods. These cultural features include the aboriginal culture, the multicultural when Taiwan is under Dutch and Spanish rule and in the Zheng period, the culture of reclaiming agriculture, the modern culture when Taiwan is under Japanese rule, the society transition of modern Taiwan, the development and transition of the modern literature and art, popular culture and globalization.

description.zh: 中國文化淵遠流長，歷數千年而不衰，涵蓋範園既廣且深。本課程授課內容，是透過物質生活(衣、食、住、行)，集體生活(社會、政治組織)，精神生活(文學、藝術、哲學、宗教信仰)等之介紹，讓學生對中國文化有更進一步的認識與了解。授課方式以口頭講授為主，討論及書面報告為輔，使得上課方式更為生動與活潑。
description.en: Chinese culture is a time-honored history, and never fades after undergoing several thousand years. The scope of Chines culture is immeasurable and deep. The contents of this course including the introduction of material life (clothing, food, housing and transportation), collective life (society, politics, and organization), and spiritual life (literature, art, philosophy and religious belief). Students will obtain further cognition and acquaintance about Chinese culture. The teaching mode is by giving students a lecture orally, and students have to discuss and hand in written reports. The teaching style is more vivacious.

description.zh: 文字是高度文明社會的產物，在社群中，繼語言的溝通目的，進而成為記載與保存的重要媒介。中國幅員廣大地域又常隔絕，書寫和通讀一種共通的文字對於多民族的融合與歷史文化的傳承深具關鍵作用。中國的文字相對於西洋拼音文字又稱為漢字，由於書寫工具及負載材料的變易，文字書寫發展出歷代遞嬗各風貌，尤其毛筆的運用展現各階段多樣的線條藝術。隨著傳統士人身份發生變化，依附於傳統文化並作為傳統政教倫理工具和文人清譽標誌的書法，也產生價值跌宕。書法在歷史流變中逐漸成為獨立藝術，民國以來以現代型態的美學觀念闡釋書法這一古典傳統藝術，從而確立書法的現代美學性質。
description.en: Compared to Western phonetic writing, Chinese writing is also known as Han characters. Due to changes in writing tools and materials, the development of Chinese writing has undergone various transformations throughout the ages, with the use of brushes showcasing various styles of line art at different stages. As the traditional scholar identity evolved, calligraphy, which relied on traditional culture and served as a tool for political education and a badge of honor for literati, also experienced fluctuations in value. Calligraphy gradually became an independent art form over time and has been interpreted with modern aesthetic concepts since the establishment of the Republic of China, thus establishing the modern aesthetic nature of calligraphy.

description.zh: 本課程是針對有志從事文化創意產業的學生而設計的創意策略與企劃課程。課程從廣告的基本概念開始說明，如產品的開發策略、市場規模估計、競爭產品的研究和分析、消費者行為研究、SWOT、3C等。本課程的目的是以創新思考和市場行銷概念引導學生，並鼓勵學生從當前的創意產業中，發掘潛在機會，以創造新鮮且有趣的想法。
description.en: This course is a strategy and general project management for students interested in pursuing careers in the cultural and creative industry. The course starts from the basic concepts and functions in the advertising, such as the development of product strategy, market size estimation, competitor identification and analysis, consumer behavior research, SWOT, 3Cs, and so on. This course aims to guide students equipped with innovation thinking and marketing sense. Additionally, the course drives students to look through potential opportunities in the creative industry and to implement new and interesting ideas.

syllabi.outline:
企劃，雖是紙上談兵，但有意思的提案確實可幫助與這計畫相關的人，不只是客戶，還有同事、支援團隊（如協力單位、廠商）等，都得以進入情境，進而讓紙上提案，成為實際發生的專案。

課程目標：1. 同學將理解「每個專案以概念清楚為首要，後續才有文案與視覺設計」的次序性；2.案例分析。

本課程以近年的展覽為研究案例。近年藝術、展覽、文創等領域，開始有了新面貌，但在各種習以為常的狀態裡，發掘「新意義」是永遠不變的課題，即使是探究過去，也應發掘與「此刻社會」的關係。課程預計分成三階段：階段一，同學將理解企劃提案的基本原則。階段二、三，則希望同學以原則為基礎，開始變形。課堂將提供與我們時下社會相關的題目，預期透過「觀察」、「紀錄」、「分析」與「摘要重點」四項基礎，培養同學的觀察、搜集資料、分析與提案能力。因此，這不在於題目是否具備商業價值，而是鼓勵同學能提出能感動他人的企劃提案。

*鼓勵同學於課餘時間，盡可能從「觀察、紀錄」中，探索你的生活環境。

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋文化典藏的徵集、維護與管理過程，並著重各項資料的編排、描述與加值應用。課程目標在培養學生具備文化典藏智能，包括：1. 認識文化典藏機構、典藏物件的類型與特性，以及永久保存的相關概念；2. 理解文化典藏著錄的方式與基本原則；3. 具備文化典藏資料查找、評估與運用之素養。
description.en: This course covers the process of acquiring, maintaining and managing cultural collections, and focuses on the organization, description and value-added application of various collection. The goal of the course is to provide students with knowledge of cultural collections, including: 1. an understanding of the types and characteristics of institutions and objects in cultural collections, as well as the concept of permanent preservation; 2. an understanding of the methods and basic principles of description in cultural collections; 3. the ability to locate, evaluate, and apply information in cultural collections.

syllabi.outline: 本課程涵蓋數位時代中一手檔案史料的整理與數位化過程，著重檔案資料的典藏管理與加值應用。課程目標在於培養學生的檔案智能，包括：1. 認識檔案資料類型與特性，以及數位保存的相關概念；2. 理解檔案編排分類與描述著錄等資訊組織的基本原則3. 具備檔案資料查找、評估與運用數位典藏等檔案專業素養。

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include: probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with frequently used statistical methods and theories. Students will be able to draw appropriate conclusions through problem identification, data collection, and appropriate statistical analysis methods. The course includes: descriptive statistics, probability concepts, probability distribution, interval estimation, hypothesis test, variance analysis, and regression analysis.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Data and Statistics.

3. Descriptive Statistics: Numerical Measures.
4. Introduction to Probability.
5. Discrete Probability Distributions.
6. Continuous Probability Distributions.
7. Sampling and Sampling Distributions.
8. Interval Estimation.

Final exam

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，配合設計實務的操作，使學生能充分了解使用者介面設計的流程以及相關的應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作的能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work.

description.en: This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。 課程規劃主要著重在"設計方法"以及"設計思維(Design Thinking)的實際操作演練;希望透過本課程讓同學們以互動體驗實作的方式來建構設計概念發展的模式。 課程內容包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫及實作等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discussion.

description.zh: 以傳授設計原理、平面及立體設計觀念、美的形式原理、平面及立體的構成練習、對各種視覺媒材特性的應用經驗，以及造形與色彩的研究達到對視覺設計感覺的養成，並提高計畫性創造能力，是發展實用性及機能性以前之視覺設計訓練的基礎。
description.en: This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. In the first semester, learning materials of the course include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生在多媒體設計上的音樂製作與聲音設計之理論與實務訓練，透過 MIDI 概念講解、數位音樂製作流程介紹、作品欣賞、軟體操作、實務聲音設計與錄製、電腦輔助音樂製作實務，來強化學生在音樂與聲音設計上的審美能力、企劃能力、與實作能力。
description.en: This course aims to enhance students' theoretical and practical ability of music production and sound design in multimedia. It is intended to strengthen students' aesthetic, planning, and production ability of sound. Topics covered in this course include MIDI, music production, music appreciation, software operation, sound design, recording techniques as well as computer-assisted music arrangement.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供給對於電子音樂、聲音藝術、數位音樂、遊戲配樂、以及聲音相關研究等有興趣的學習者們一系列有效工具的介紹與實務練習，並為學習者建立數位音樂、遊戲配樂、聲音設計的基本概念。本課程透過介紹音訊編輯的技術、相關聲音設計工具的使用，學習創意的聲音設計與電子音樂製作。課程當中，除了聲音設計的工具介紹之外，並教導學生使用 Ableton Live 序列器軟體，搭配 Max for Live 的聲音設計工具，讓使用者可以在序列器中使用自己所設計的軟體合成器與數位位效果器，進而可延伸至多媒體、遊戲、新媒體展演等之音樂與音效應用。此外，本課程亦將結合「自適性音樂」的技術，透過中介軟體 FMOD 與遊戲引擎 Unity 進行結合，建立自適音樂的雛形架構，作為互動設計的音樂設計依據。

This course mainly introduces sound design and electronic music production tools and skills. Through the introduction of audio editing technology and the use of related sound design tools, students can learn creative sound design. In the course, students are taught to use the Ableton Live sequencer software, combined with its sound design tools in Max for Live, to design their own software synthesizers and digital effects to be used in the sequencer. These skills may be used in multimedia design, game audio, new media performances, and etc. In addition, this course will also cover the concept and technology of "adaptive music", integrating the middleware FMOD into the game engine Unity to establish a prototype framework of adaptive music for interactive design.

第七週：合成器架構簡介、drum rack、macro 自動化控制、wavetable synthesis
第八週：Max for Live 簡介（一）- 合成器設計

description.en: This course is focused on the introduction of animation planning and design, as well as its principle and application. Through the study on the internet, animation, game and other digital media, students can understand the design process of animation, story drafting and software application.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。

透過理論講解和操作示範介紹電腦動畫的原理和方法。除了功能的訓練之外同時也著重動畫的美感、創造性、表演性等等運用面的需求。
使用軟體是以3Ds Max為主，在熟悉3ds max工具的同時，更明確的認清原創為藝術創作的首要目標，以利用此軟體多元並高度的掌控性，重組現實世界的運行法則，像是重力、光影、質感等，並企圖創造出各種感知進化的契機。此動畫課程除了包含進階的建模、材質與運算，將加入角色製作與攝影機語言的敘述搭配空間與物件造形所傳達之視覺感知，將時間性的美感與張力融入創作。

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 多元英文系列課程以強化英語文實務及溝通能力為目標，提供不同主題內容及學習任務之課程。本系列課程整合語言技巧之訓練、專業內容主題之教授、及功能性之實務英文應用。課程設計主軸包括任務導向教學、主題式教學、及互動式語言訓練並導入多樣性之語言素材。修習課程前應詳細了解個別課程內容並評估個別英語應用之需求。
description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

syllabi.schedule:
Week:1
Topic: Introduction to modern programming languages 介紹近代程式設計語言與差異(機械語言、組合語言、C/C++/C#語言、Java/Python語言、程式設計的重點與目標)

Week: 2
Topic: Program Variables and Operators 基本程式設計之變數、常數與資料運算元

Week: 3
Topic: Program Output 基本程式設計之螢幕輸出 Print

Week: 4
Topic: Program Loop 程式迴圈 (說明 for, while 迴圈的基礎認識，與迴圈終止方式)

Week: 5
Topic: Program Jump and Flow Control 邏輯判斷 (說明 if, else 邏輯判緞的基礎認識)

Week: 6
Topic: Array, List and Dictionary 陣列、串列與字典(說明各種進階資料結構的基本運算方式)

Week: 7
Topic: Windows Controls Processing 程式視窗輸出 (說明視窗元件的基本控制方式)

Week: 8
Topic: Windows Program 視窗程式設計 (前述技巧與綜合應用)

Week: 9
Topic: 期中考試

Week: 10
Topic: User Defined Function 自訂副程式 (說明 自訂函式，與呼叫方式)

Week: 11
Topic: String Processing One 字串處理-1 (說明字串變數與字串常數的差異，交互套用字串變數與字串常數的方式)

Week: 12
Topic: File Processing One 檔案處理-1 (說明磁碟檔案的基本認識與操作方式)

Week: 13
Topic: String Processing Two 字串處理-2 (說明字串變數操作與部分資料擷取)

Week: 14
Topic: Simple Constructive Program 簡易結構化程式設計 (前述技巧與綜合應用)

Week: 15
Topic: File Processing Two 檔案處理 (說明檔案操作與字串變數的進階操作方式)

Week: 16
Topic: Exception Handle 例外處理 (說明 try-except 基礎認識，與錯誤處理方式)

Week: 17
Topic: Debug Skills 除錯技巧 (說明 程式錯誤的偵測方式)

Week: 18
Topic: 期末考試

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. syllabi.outline:
本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，配合設計實務的操作，使學生能充分了解使用者介面設計的流程以及相關的應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作的能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
        期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 銜接工程圖學及基本幾何學的觀念，以繪製機械之零件圖、立體圖、剖面圖與組合圖，並能正確的標註尺度、表面加工符號及公差與配合。
description.en: Connecting the fundamental Engineering graphics and the geometrical drawing technology to mechanical parts and assembly drawings with emphasizes on mastering the intersections and development theorem, Steel Structures, Hydraulic and Fluid Systems and Related Mechanical Drawing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之學習目標是要銜接正投影及工程圖學的觀念，以繪製機械零件之三視圖、輔助視圖、特殊視圖、剖面視圖，以及學習繪製組合圖。其次要學習機械零件之立體圖繪製，實物測量與繪製工作圖，並能正確的標註尺度、公差與配合、以及表面粗糙度與表面符號。
The learning objectives of this course are to connect the concepts of orthographic projection and engineering graphics to draw three views, auxiliary views, special views, section views of mechanical parts, and learn to draw composite drawings. Secondly, learn the three-dimensional drawing of mechanical parts, physical measurement and drawing of working drawings, and be able to correctly mark dimensions, tolerances and fits, as well as surface roughness and surface symbols.
