name.en: Special Integration Topics on Technology in Cultural and Creative Industry

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討如何整合科技於文化創意產業，透過案例教學，幫助學生結合有效率的資訊科技工具於人文藝術，以發展文化創意產業，並創造高附加價值的效益。當今產、官、學、研都強調跨域整合的重要性，文創與互動科技的結合，能為文化創意作加值，並注入新生命、新體驗，因此，文創遇到科技後，所激盪出的火花與創意，已逐漸受到產、學界的青睞。本課程將探討文化創意的發展脈絡、文創的底蘊與其應用面、互動科技的應用，透過文獻研讀、案例分析等方式，瞭解國外最新研究與趨勢，討論文創與科技的創新應用可行性，引領文化創意產業轉型，規劃未來文創與科技整合的新契機。
description.en: The course intends to explore about how to integrate the technology into the cultural and creative Industries. Through case study, it will help students to combine efficient information technology tools in the field of arts and humanities, and also facilitate the development of cultural and creative industries, and create high value-added benefits for these industries. Today's industry, government, academia, research has emphasized the importance of cross-discipline consolidation. It means that cultural creation and interactive technology combined with value-added as a bonus for the cultural creation, and implant new life, new experiences. Therefore, when the cultural creation encounter technology, which bring out the spark and creativity, has gradually been favored both with industry  and academia. description.en: This course is a joint seminar for all the doctoral students, which will be progressed by paper presentation of special topics on design issues, giving lectures, and group meeting.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。

description.zh:
本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。
本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。
本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en:
This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.
This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

description.zh:
設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.描述設計方法的演變
2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異
3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制
4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程
5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en:
Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.
Upon completing this course, you will be able to:
1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies 
2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer   
3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology
4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part  
5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en:
The function of industrial design in the 21st  century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. 
         	Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.
The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.zh: 本課程旨在以個別與小組合作模式，訓練學生通曉設計開發流程，以執行設計專案。藉由實務案例的運作，及兼顧產業與組織之需求，以體現產業與社會文化面的問題與解決對策。本課程又以培育學生具備專業設計師之設計企劃提案與概念發想能力，以及學生使用設計工具之能力。
description.en: The goal of Advanced Product Design (II) is to train, under supervision, students in strategic areas of the product development process. In these projects, the students work alone or in groups. The projects are usually based on problems defined within different branches of industry and social sectors. Project work is usually done under realistic conditions, in collaboration with different industrial companies or public institutions. Students can contribute to this reality by developing sensible and usable products and systems which include qualities that speak to the heart and mind of people. We educate students as designers to have an open mind on both conceptual ideas and detailed realistic design solutions in order to develop higher quality products. Another important focus area of this course is to improve the students' capabilities in the use of modern design tools.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the environmental aspects of nanoscience and nanotechnology. We will study the fundamental physical-chemical properties, synthesis and characterization, environmental implications, health and environmental impact, and environmental applications of nanoparticles and nanomaterials. Topics about the generation, collection, and measurement of nano-particle will also be covered. Case studies from recent publications on engineered carbon nanomaterials and nanomaterials on catalysis will be discussed.

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

syllabi.outline: To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most important tools for analyzing and assessing environmental problems will be taught during the course of the semester. Students will also be learning a popular LCA software, SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as carbon footprinting and labeling, and eco-design will also be practiced in the class.

description.en: This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and techniques required in Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI). The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction to precision metrology and machine vision, the measurement principles and methods used in the 2D AOI, the measurement principles and techniques used in the 3D AOI, image processing and artificial intelligence methods used in automatic inspection, intelligent measurement systems, AOI system integration and conclusion.

This course aims to introduce the concept, methodology, and algorithms of Automatic Optical Inspection and machine vision as well as the hardware and software used by automatic optical inspection. The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon automatic optical inspection so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to solve quality inspection problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of automatic optical inspection.

syllabi.outline:
介紹電腦輔助工程和有限元素分析的基本原理。講授分析軟體ANSYS的操作方法和技術。指導學生練習平面應力或傳熱問題的有限元素分析。培養學生進行獨立有限元素分析的能力。培養學生以正確的態度使用有限元素分析。介紹工程分析，有限元素模型構建，高級模塊技術，實體模型構建，一維元素分析，二維元素分析，三維元素分析和高級範例。
Introduce the basic principles of computer-aided engineering and finite element analysis.
Teaching the operation methods and techniques for the analysis software ANSYS.
Guide students to practice finite element analysis of plane stress or heat transfer problems.
Develop students with the ability to perform independent finite element analysis.
Cultivate students with the correct attitude of using finite element analysis.
Introduction to engineering analysis, finite element model building, advanced module techniques, solid model building, one-dimensional element analysis, two-dimensional element analysis, three-dimensional element analysis, and advanced examples.

第3週 電腦輔助工程與有限元素方法概論：有限元方法，多部分多項式。
第4週 電腦輔助工程和有限元素方法概論：各種邊界條件，位移和力條件。
第5週 1. ANSYS結構； 2. ANSYS介面； 3.在線幫助系統； 4. ANSYS系統； 5. ANSYS命令語言。
第6週 1.平面應力分析導論； 2.問題分析； 3，元素選擇和屬性；4，實體造型；5，有限元素建模；6.計算機實驗室實踐

description.zh: 本課程以機械製造結合工業4.0技術為主，包括近代製造技術概論、E化製造、物聯網基本介紹、巨量資料於製程優化的應用、智慧型演算之原理與應用、機器視覺檢測應用、彈性製造系統、網宇實體系統、智能化工廠應用實例、應用APP撰寫等，增進學生對現代製造技術內容之理解、內化、與判斷應用能力，並加強工業4.0相關最新科技之介紹與應用，以期培養對應用聯網技術、大數據、雲端運算、及人工智慧於製造相關課題有技術與能力之工程師。
description.en: This course is based on integration of mechanical manufacturing and industry 4.0, which is made of the modern manufacturing, the computational manufacturing,the internet of things, the optimization of manufacturing using big data, the intelligent calculation, machine vision measurement, flexible manufacturing, CPS system, smart factory, APP, etc.. This course can improve student’s knowledge of modern manufacturing, judgment, and industry 4.0, which will further create engineers with networking technology, big data, cloud calculation, and artificial intelligence in manufacturing.

name.en: The theory and practice of 3D Printing

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以實務為主，學生需要學習擠製成型(ME)、光固化聚合(VP)、材料噴印(MJ)與粉床融合(PBF)等類的三維列印機的設計原理。首先將以熔融擠製成型類的三維列印機兩種機構設計的拆卸與組裝，再透過機台的校正後，列印出可接受的品質物件。第二種機台為DLP類的光固化聚合三維列印機，透過軟體的教學帶領學生考慮支撐建構的原則與列印方向對列印品的差異性比較。第三台為Object的材料噴印三維列印機，透過機台的使用可以了解噴印的原理，並建構較為細緻的特徵。第四台為選擇性雷射金屬燒結列印機，讓學生可以了解晶格結構對機械性質的影響等。本課程鼓勵學生在修課後，參加IPAS 3D列印實作考科之工程師級考試。
ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the processes of Vat Photopolymerization and Material Extrusion, hardware, software, and material will be studied, The implementation of these two type systems will be given. The course will encourage students to take IPAS exam in 3D Printing practice.

description.zh: 課程內容包括：課程分為三部分，第一、接合技術之基礎：材料表面結構和接合力學。第二、介紹一般工程用接合技術：機械接合、銲接、銲接冶金、軟硬銲、金屬-陶瓷接合、擴散鍵結、和膠合。第三、接合應用：真空系統和微電子接合和密封結構介紹。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first three chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of joining, including: Introduction, Surface science, and The mechanics of joining. The next six chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the joining and assembly of the components of an engineering system, including: Mechanical bonding, Welding, Welding Metallurgy, Soldering & Brazing, Metal-Ceramic Joints & Diffusion Bonding, Adhesives, and Structural Adhesives. The last two chapters take two areas of special interest, vacuum system and microelectronics, and survey the range of resolutions to joining problems which have been developed for these specific application.

syllabi.outline: 課程內容包括：課程分為三部分，第一、接合技術之基礎：材料表面結構和接合力學。第二、介紹一般工程用接合技術：機械接合、銲接、銲接冶金、軟硬銲、金屬-陶瓷接合、擴散鍵結和膠合。第三、接合應用：真空系統和微電子接合和密封結構介紹。

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。變分微積分與最佳化之關係及其在工程最佳化上之應用、端點條件、不連續最佳化程序、無限制及有限制條件最佳化問題、直接法及實際最佳化設計應用等。
description.en: Introduction of Variational Calculus and its Application in the Engineering Optimal Design, Constrained/Unconstrained Optimal Design Problems, Discrete Optimal Control and Mathematical Programming, Practical Examples of Optimum Design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在建立學生對於機械最佳化設計之基本概念，包含如何將設計問題的物理模型以數學模型形式建立目標函數，並依照給定限制條件求解目標函數之極值或最佳化值問題。課程內容共分為五個部分：(1) 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎、(2) 常用之一維搜尋最佳化方法、(3) 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法、(4) 限制問題的最佳化方法、(5) 機械最佳化設計實例分析。
This course aims to establish the basic concept of mechanical optimization design for students, including how to establish the mathematical model of objective function from the physical model, and solve the problem by finding the extremum or the optimal value of the objective function according to the given constraints. The course content is divided into five parts: (1) Mathematical analysis basis of objective function in optimization design, (2) Commonly used one-dimensional optimization method, (3) Optimization method for unlimited multi-dimensional problem, (4) The optimization method of the restriction problem, (5) Example of the mechanical optimization design.

第5週

description.zh: 人工智慧、5G行動通訊、雲端運算、區塊鏈、大數據、物聯網、無線區域網路、汽車電子、近場通訊、行動支付、智慧生活等，科技發展日新月異，便利你我的生活，但也助長了新的犯罪手段，專注新興科技的同時，資訊安全更要與時俱進。本課程將著重於資訊安全的基礎知識，以及對於現今通用的各種資訊安全觀念、技術、管理與應用給予整體性的認識，未來可進一步修習相關進階課程。
description.en: The rapid development of science and technology facilitates your life and mine, such as artificial intelligence, 5G mobile communication, cloud computing, blockchain, big data, Internet of Things, wireless local area network, vehicle electronics, near field communication, mobile payment, smart life, etc., but it also encourages new criminal methods. While focusing on emerging technologies, information security must move with the times. This course will focus on the basic knowledge of information security, giving whole understanding of various information security concepts, technologies, management and applications in common use today. In the future, students can further study related advanced courses.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

name.en: Railway Signal and Traffic Control System

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道號誌系統的內涵。號誌系統是列車運行的控制系統。其功用必需兼顧整個鐵道運輸系統的「安全」、「迅速」、與「經濟」。由於號誌系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與控制等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道號誌系統專家、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊與自動控制等三部分提出號誌系統規劃與評估報告，並邀請鐵道號誌系統專家擔任評審。
description.en: This course is one of the optional courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The goal of this course is, via both in-class lecturing and field-trip visiting, to have participant students realize the contents of Railway Signal System. The signal system is the control system of train operation. To give consideration to safety, rapidness and economy of entire railway transportation system, this system will be required. Since the signal system is the technology including management, communication and automatic control, this course is a joint-lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors for the participant students include experts on railway signal system from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In the student reports, they will demonstrate the railway signal system planning and evaluation report for the management, communication and automatic control.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。基本概念、生產預測、產品/服務設計、生產製程與產能規劃、設施佈置、工作系統設計、生產計劃、生產管制、存貨管理、全面品質管理、設備預防保養。
description.en: Fundamental Concepts, Production Forecasting Product/Service Design, Production Processes and Capacity planning, Facility Layout, Job system Design, Production planning, Production Control, Inventory Control, Total Quality Management, Preventive Maintenance.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要的課程目標是希望能夠加強學生在作業管理方面的知識。課程內容主要涵蓋了策略議題與實務應用兩部分，包括預測、產品與服務的設計、產能規劃、品質管理、供應鏈管理、存貨管理與排程等議題。作業管理相關領域的觀念、工具及應用，對從事與製造業相關工作的人來說，乃必備知識。因此，對主修機械的同學來說，瞭解作業管理相關領域的觀念、工具及應用，是相當重要的。由於本課程與機械系一般技術課程，在觀念上有很大的不同，所以建議同學在課餘時間可以多看看報紙、雜誌及電視上，有關製造業經營管理與產業發展的報導。
The main goal of this course is to strengthen students' knowledge of homework management. The course content mainly covers two parts: strategic issues and practical applications, including forecasting, product and service design, capacity planning, quality management, supply chain management, inventory management and scheduling. The concepts, tools, and applications in the field of job management are essential knowledge for those engaged in manufacturing-related jobs. Therefore, it is very important for students majoring in mechanics to understand the concepts, tools and applications in the related fields of homework management. Since this course is very different in concept from the general technical courses in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, it is recommended that students should read more newspapers, magazines and TV reports on manufacturing management and industrial development in their spare time.

name.zh: 數位化設計與開發特論
name.en: Special Topics on e-Design and e-Development

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

syllabi.outline:
工業4.0全球化製造體系的形成，使得製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種資通訊技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造先進製造系統。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明工業4.0數位製造的應用現況與未來發展所需之相關技術。本課程的內容包括：工業4.0商業模型、工業4.0相關技術說明、產品設計與開發、資訊系統與整合、眾設平台與新零售、供應鏈管理CPFR系統、工業物聯網架構。
The formation of the Industry 4.0 global manufacturing system requires manufacturers to adopt a more active attitude, starting from a strategic perspective, and using various information and communication technologies to integrate internal and external processes and information to create an advanced manufacturing system. The purpose of digital manufacturing is to enhance the competitive advantage of the entire manufacturing system through information transparency. The design of the course is a conceptual introduction to explain the current application status of Industry 4.0 digital manufacturing and related technologies required for future development. The content of this course includes: Industry 4.0 business model, Industry 4.0 related technical description, product design and development, information system and integration, crowd-building platform and new retail, supply chain management CPFR system, and industrial Internet of Things architecture.

name.en: Principles and Practices of  Cloud Computing

description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務有全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1.雲端運算發展近況及基本概念2.資源虛擬化之基本概念與技術，3.雲端運算相關技術、效能與安全，4.虛擬化資料中心建置-虛擬計算、儲存、網路與應用，6.雲端服務規劃，7.雲端之基礎設施服務、平台服務、軟體服務介紹，8.專題討論。
description.en:
Cloud Computing, either private, public or hybrid, is dramatically transforming every aspect of IT. Now it has become ubiquitous these days, and is the key foundation for developing technologies of Big Data and Internet of Things (IoT). Its deployment starts delivering applications with more benefits than the existing legacy infrastructure.

Because the terms are broadly quoted and adopted, then by this course, the Cloud Computing core technologies and the associated below will be well introduced:
1.Cloud Computing Basic Concept 
2.Resources Virtualization & Software Defined Data Center (SDDC)
3.Cloud Computing Security 
4.Cloud Technologies
5.Cloud Service Planning and Deployment 
6.Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
7.Platform as a Service (PaaS)
8.Software as a Services (SaaS)
9.Cloud Service Operations 
10.Case Studies and presentation

工業自動化基本控制元件的設計觀念、使用方法與應用規劃；內容包含人機介面裝置(Human Machine Interface, HMI)、可程式邏輯控制器(Programmable Logic Controller, PLC)、交流伺服馬達(AC Servo Motor)的原理解說與應用設計實作課程。
description.en:
Pre-requisites：Digital Circuit, Microprocessor

The fundamental design concepts、operations and application development of industrial automation controllers are focused. Architectures and applications design of Human Machine Interface(HMI), Programmable Logic Controller(PLC) and AC Servo Motor are introduced. Hands-on work and exercises are included.

二級警戒時以遠距加分流為原則。分流以班為單位到校，平時評量不佳同學優先到校上課，其他則一半同學輪流到校上課，增加互動與學習效果。

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

syllabi.outline:
奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
The application of nano-micron engineering in biomedicine is becoming more and more important. The development of measurement and operation tools is closely related to the size of actual biomedical application objects. A full understanding of biological systems is one of the important processes of engineering performance. In this course, the principle explanation and application discussion will be carried out with the current research equipment in our laboratory, including the sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules. Elective students should choose the topics and project content of the mid-term report in the fields of nano-micron biomedical sensing system, nano-biomedical materials, nano-biomedical optoelectronics, and laboratory chips. The main requirement is to seek innovative thinking , In order to seek breakthroughs in principles or applications, and actively promote integrated research across fields and advanced technologies.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電子顯微鏡之結構，成像及繞射原理，以及在材料科學方面之應用，課程內容包括穿透式電子顯微鏡之構造，電磁透鏡與成像原理，電子繞射原理，繞射圖型分析，試片之製作方法。掃描式電子顯微鏡之構造及成像原理。EDS及WDS之X光光譜測量。
description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science.  The course contents include structure of the transmission electron microscope, the electromagnetic lens and theory of image formation, theory of electronic diffraction, analysis of diffraction pattern, and the preparation of test sample.  The structure and principle of forming image for a scanning electron microscope, the X-ray spectrography of EDS and WDS are also included in this course.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
表面現象, 介面反應等與近代高科技技術, 如鍍膜工程,表面處理, 腐蝕, 磨潤, 微機電, 感測器, 半導體技術等息息相關, 且日益重要。表面分析是原子層次的相關研究, 它包括振動, 電子或離子頻譜分析, 微技術等之應用。主要的項目包含, 表面形貌觀察( SEM, BSEM, AFM ), 成份分析( 光譜分析, 質譜分析, EDX ), 結構分析( XRD, AES, ESCA, XPS ), 鍵結分析( Raman光譜, FTIR ), 表面粗糙度, 膜厚, 附著力, 內應力等膜之特性分析。
description.en:
Surface phenomena and processes occurring at interface are becoming increasingly important in a wide variety of industrial applications including the areas of films coating surface treatments, conclusion, triobology, microelectronics, sensors and semi-conductor technologies.  Accompanying this is an ever-growing need for surface characterization allowing better definition of processes occurring at a microscopic level.
Surface analysis is the use of vibration, electron or ion spectroscopic and microscopic techniques for the study of material at the atomic level, it includesSEM, AFM, XRD, EDX, ESCA, XPS, AES, Raman Spectrum, and FTIR analysis.

description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en:
The function of industrial design in the 21st  century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. 
         	Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.
The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.en: The goal of Advanced Product Design (II) is to train, under supervision, students in strategic areas of the product development process. In these projects, the students work alone or in groups. The projects are usually based on problems defined within different branches of industry and social sectors. Project work is usually done under realistic conditions, in collaboration with different industrial companies or public institutions. Students can contribute to this reality by developing sensible and usable products and systems which include qualities that speak to the heart and mind of people. We educate students as designers to have an open mind on both conceptual ideas and detailed realistic design solutions in order to develop higher quality products. Another important focus area of this course is to improve the students' capabilities in the use of modern design tools.

description.zh:
設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：
1.描述設計方法的演變
2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異
3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制
4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程
5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en:
Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.
Upon completing this course, you will be able to:
1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies 
2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer   
3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology
4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part  
5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

description.zh: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。
description.en: This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

name.zh: 智慧空間互動程式設計
name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機(大疆/Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用(Open source SDK)、APP開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study.  The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

syllabi.outline:
空間設計可以將實體空間視為一個人與環境隨時互動之介面，再加上智慧代理人觀念，將促使設計者以新的介面設計觀念探索實體空間之各項設計發展可能性。課程含科技發展與哲學、智慧空間設計方法、智慧空間互動與感知技術、空間資訊控制與介面、空間資訊流與應用。
Physical space could be considered as a real-time interface included of many human-environment interactions when designing space. While the concept of intelligent agent co-jointed with spatial interface, new opportunities opened to designers to explore interactive interface designs and developments of physical space. Course contents included of development and philosophy of science and technology, design method of intelligent space, intelligent interaction and spatial perception technology, spatial information control and interface, and spatial information flow and application.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹行動裝置遊戲設計企劃所需了解之專業知識與技術，並透過設計實務的操作使學生能具備行動裝置遊戲設計企劃的實務能力。課程內容包含行動遊戲個案研究、行動遊戲市場分析、行動平台與技術研究、行動遊戲內容設計、遊戲規則與架構設計、遊戲腳本製作、遊戲情境設定等。教學將以課堂講授、分組討論、設計專案執行等方式進行，並以專題報告繳交與課堂發表為評量依據。

description.zh:
本課程將介紹資訊視覺化設計與應用的原理與基礎。課程內容將包括:
a)	資訊圖像及數位視覺的深入探討

description.en:
This course is an introduction to the principles and basic of infographic design and application. It consists of following issues:
a)	The deep study of information graphics and digital visualizations.
b)	The use of computer program language to create charts, maps and user interface.
c)	The illustrations design to tell stories and application implementation. 
In this course, you will learn to create effective and beautiful graphical displays of evidence, and to critically evaluate examples from case studies.

description.en: This course will illustrate the basic principles and applications of tissue engineering technologies. The content is consists of stem cell technologies, properties of cells and tissues, cellular-fate process, cell and tissue culture, gene transfer, cell and tissue separation, biomaterials for scaffold, testing of tissue engineered medical products (TEMPs), and the commercialization process for TEMPs.

syllabi.outline: This course is intended to provide you with an introduction to recent biomedical research activities in the area of tissue engineering. The term "tissue engineering" has been coined to describe the interdisciplinary field concerned with the study of generation or regeneration of tissues. Researchers in this area utilize knowledge of the molecular basis of cellular function and interactions, in combination with fundamental engineering principles, to gain insights into tissue structure and function, with the purpose of developing bioartificial tissues or enhancing native tissue function.

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於未來智慧互動城市發展的理論、方法、技術應用與案例分析。在智慧城市中，民眾透過主動、被動、自主和社群平台進行交流和合作，以實現不同的生活目標。學生將獲得有關智慧互動城市領域主要研究主題和實驗實踐的知識，培養她/他在建設智慧互動城市方面的技能。課程內容主要將從互動和設計的角度介紹和討論不同的範例，例如普適計算、環境智能、增強和虛擬現實、環境智能、可適化人機介面、操作性介面、物聯網、智慧家居、社會規範、及空間感知…等的應用情境與案例分析。與課程中，也將帶入不同的社會挑戰，並於學生分組專題，透過跨領域共作的模式，提出未來互動設計應用與智慧城市的方案。本課程將分為理論部分和實踐部分。理論部分涵蓋了開發和評估智慧互動系統的理論架構和方法，以及其實踐與應用方法。理論部分的部分內容將透過分組專題，同時學習理論的內容及其應用實踐的實務。

syllabi.outline:
本課程聚焦於未來智慧互動城市發展的理論、方法、技術應用與案例分析。在智慧城市中，民眾透過主動、被動、自主和社群平台進行交流和合作，以實現不同的生活目標。學生將獲得有關智慧互動城市領域主要研究主題和實驗實踐的知識，培養她/他在建設智慧互動城市方面的技能。課程內容主要將從互動和設計的角度介紹和討論不同的範例，例如普適計算、環境智能、增強和虛擬現實、環境智能、可適化人機介面、操作性介面、物聯網、智慧家居、社會規範、及空間感知…等的應用情境與案例分析。與課程中，也將帶入不同的社會挑戰，並於學生分組專題，透過跨領域共作的模式，提出未來互動設計應用與智慧城市的方案。本課程將分為理論部分和實踐部分。理論部分涵蓋了開發和評估智慧互動系統的理論架構和方法，以及其實踐與應用方法。理論部分的部分內容將透過分組專題，同時學習理論的內容及其應用實踐的實務。
The main theme of the course is theories, methods, technologies and case studies for the development of future smart interactive cities where humans and proactive, reactive, autonomous and social platform communicate and cooperate to reach goals. The student will acquire knowledge about main research themes and experimental practices in the field of smart interactive cities as well as develop her/his skills in constructing smart interactive cities. Different paradigms will be introduced and discussed, primarily from an interaction and design perspective such as ubiquitous computing, ambient intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, intelligent and adaptive user interfaces, tangible interfaces, persuasive technology, decision-support systems, Internet of Things, smart homes, social norms, and spatial awareness. Different societal challenges will also be addressed through cross-disciplinary collaboration in student projects. The course is divided into theoretical parts and practical parts. Course topic response reports, a midterm project proposal report, and a 4000 words final project report should be submitted in this course.
syllabi.schedule:
Unit One: Image of the City (Kevin Lynch)

Unit Two: A Pattern language (Christopher Alexander, Sara Ishikawa, Murray Silverstein)

Unit Three: Form follow Function or Function follow Form?

Unit Four: What is a Smart City? How "Smart" a city can be?

Unit Five: Space Syntax Analysis of a City.

Unit Six: Human-Centered City with Human Behavior Observation.

Unit Seven: City with Sensors and Network Technology.

Unit Eight: City with Big Data and Computing Technology.

Unit Nine: City Intelligence for planning, management, and decision making.

description.zh: 1. 數學基礎 1.1 函數成長率之漸近性質 1.2 遞迴關係之解 1.3 數學歸納法 2. 基本分析技巧 2.1 計算複雜度之上下限2.2 最差情況分析及平均情況分析 2.3 動態平均分析 3. 基本設計技巧 3.1 分擊法 3.2 貪婪法 3.3 動態規劃 3.4 隨機演算法 4. 計算複雜度 4.1 資訊理論證明法 4.2 對抗式證明法 4.3 問題之線性轉換 4.4 完全NP

Basic analysis techniques 2.1 Computational complexities -- lower bounds and upper bounds 2.2 Worst case analysis and average case analysis 2.3 Amortized analysis 3. Basic Design Paradigms 3.1 Divide and conquer 3.2 Greedy methods 3.3 Dynamic programming 3.4 Probabilistic algorithms 4. Computational Complexity 4.1 Information-theoretic arguments 4.2 Adversary arguments 4.3 Linear reduction of problems 4.4 NP-completeness

syllabi.outline: The course gives a broad introduction about the design and analysis of computer algorithms. General topics to be covered include: growth of functions, recurrences, sorting and order statistics, fundamental and advanced data structures, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.

description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques used in the field of digital image processing (IP). Digital Image Processing has many important applications, for example, image contents improvement, industrial inspection, machine perception. The outline of this course is: 1.Digital image fundamentals 2.Image transforms 3.Image enhancement 4. Image restoration 5. Color image processing 6. Image compression 7. Image segmentation and feature detection 8. Representation and description 9. Recognition and interpretation.

description.zh: 人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧"的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1.搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。
description.en: Artificial intelligence seeks to introduce the elements of intelligence into programs and systems in application domain. Topics will include 1. Searching methods 2. Propositional and Predicate logic 3. Theorem Proving 4. Knowledge-based systems and representation of knowledge 5. Machine learning, 6. Genetic algorithms and evolutionary computing, 7. Intelligent agents.

syllabi.outline:
人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧"的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1.搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。
Artificial intelligence seeks to introduce the elements of intelligence into programs and systems in application domain. Topics will include 1. Searching methods 2. Propositional and Predicate logic 3. Theorem Proving 4. Knowledge-based systems and representation of knowledge 5. Machine learning, 6. Genetic algorithms and evolutionary computing, 7. Intelligent agents.

syllabi.schedule:
一、先修課程：大學部之基礎力學

二、簡介：本課程將介紹各種動態系統模型處理，及其模擬與分析方法。模型處理之方法中，包括：牛頓之向量法、Lagrange及Hamilton法等，而模擬之方式則是以電腦輔助模擬為主，特別是商用之工程CAE套裝軟體、MATLAB 與Mathematica等，都將在本課程中介紹。

三、教學目的與目標：本課程主要目的是以模型建構之為目標，以提供解決工程問題的模擬，同時也藉以該有效系統模型來預測系統之可能行為。因此，本課程除了提供學生一「自行建構有效的動態模型」之方法外，也提供系統之分析與判讀，以及能夠進一步應用到研究及實際工程上。

四、課程內容：
1.	前言與緒論：發展與演進
2.	座標系統及其轉換
	電腦輔助：應用Mathematica於座標轉換
3.	系統的負載效應及估計
	加速度、速度、位移及外力負載
	負載之估計與估算、實驗(optional) 
	常用之模型及CAE估算
4.	系統模型化處理
	模型處理的技法：離散化、抽象化、分離化、…
	數學表示法：運動方程式
	向量法、能量法
	系統延伸：MDOF
	非傳統模型(optional)
5.	電腦輔助動態分析、模擬及判別
	電腦輔助推導：Mathematica
	狀態方程式及建構
	等效線性化
	模擬方塊：Matlab SimuLink  
	Matlab programming 
6.	模擬結果表之示法
	State space, Time and Frequency domains etc. 
	模擬小程式之建構
7.	整合例題剖析與模擬
	Mechatronic problems

To introduce the basic principle of the finite element analysis and its application in solving various types of engineering problems.
1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis
2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles
3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements
4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc.
5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc.
6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids
7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer
8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems
9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

It is expected that through the core concepts of virtual-real integration and user experience, it will apply research methods to deeply explore design problems and pain points in user experience and explore physical product design and virtual reality. We will integrate various possibilities of service design with innovative concepts. Then, we intend to utilize the implemented innovative concept by design methods, software, and hardware technologies to achieve the design services and experiences that meet and satisfy users in future life.

description.zh: 速寫是最古老、最容易、最快速的溝通方式之一，也是充滿希望的設計師及藝術家必備的絕技。藉由大量的植物寫生，提昇觀察能力並把線條練活，進而建立起掌控「形」的基本信心。接下來的靜物寫生著重整體的構圖關係，利用黑白灰的構圖原理，著眼在傳其「神」而不是傳其「形」。將前階段的單線練習，改作分塊、分面的線群練習。再接下來是人物肖像寫生練習。到此，線條的特質、比例的嚴謹皆要掌控，肖像對象的性別、年齡、特徵以及由內在而外顯的神韻，是畫者所要表達的。
description.en:
Sketching is one of the oldest, easiest and quickest methods of communication 
and also one of the most important skills a hopeful designer and artist must master. 
The course begins with a lot of plants sketching that helps to enhance your observation and build up your confidence in mastering forms and shapes in order to make your sketches vivid. Next still life sketching focuses on the composition. You are encouraged to utilize the composition principle of black, white and gray, and emphasize more on the vividness than the form until you get rid of the habit of passive copying of the objects. Then you move from the previous linear sketching practice into facet sketching and then block sketching. At the end of the semester, you will practice human portrait sketching. Until now you should be able to handle not only the characteristics of the line and proportion, but also the gender, age, charm and expression of the model.

1.	The class roster will be called twice during each class session.
2.	Those who are present in the classroom, both before the class begins and before the class ends, and with individual class material in paper form will be considered attending the required class session and will be rewarded one bonus point.
3.	Those who are not present in the classroom before the class begins, but are present before the class ends, will be considered late for the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points.
4.	Those who are present in the classroom before the class begins, but are not present before the class ends, will be considered as having left early for the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points
5.	Those who are not present in the classroom, either before the class begins or before the class ends, will be considered absent from the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points.
6.	A bonus point will not be awarded to those who do not have their own class materials.
7.	It is the discretion of an exam proctor to decide whether an academic misconduct has taken place. 
8.	If an academic misconduct is identified by an exam proctor, a zero will be given on the exam.
9. The final semester grade is composed of the average of the total number of tests, including the midterm and final exam, plus the bonus points for full attendance in class and extra credits on outstanding class performance or homework
10.	Those who earn 60 points and higher, but lower than 70 points, on the semester final grade and who are present in class for 10 or more class sessions are eligible for the make-up exam held on week 18 during class time (or at a time otherwise announced by the instructor). The make-up exam session will only be held once.

11.	The make-up exam score will be counted as 70% of the original score if it exceeds 70, but it will remain as it was when it is below 70. And the semester final grade for those who take the make-up exam will be 70 at most even if it exceeds 70 after make-up exam score is taken into account.

12.	Those who missed their exam(s) due to official absences will receive their original score instead of 70% on make-up exams after presenting the school absence note to the class teacher.

13.	Those who qualify for a make-up exam, but do not show up on time, will be considered as having been given the opportunity to take the make-up exam and their final grade will be their original grade.

description.zh: 本課程介紹密碼學的理論與實際，其主要內容如下：簡介；背景知識；DES保密系統；RSA保密系統；其他公開金匙系統；數位簽章；網路安全
description.en: Principles and practice of cryptography are covered in this course. It contains the following material:  Introduction；Background Theory；Data Encryption Standard (DES)；RSA Cryptosystem；Other Public-key Cryptosystems；Digital Signatures；Internet Security

syllabi.outline: 密碼學是一門用來設計演算法和訂定協議的科學，目的為如何在不安全的環境中達到安全的需求，如：隱私、認證、以及資料的完整性。近期，在電子通訊和電子商務的蓬勃發展下，密碼學的重要性已遠超越它在歷史上的軍事用途，而已經充滿在我們的生活當中。非常重要的是密碼學提供了實現安全的技術，例如：它讓我們可以成功使用信用卡於線上交易，同時又不洩漏卡號給其他人。 由過去25年來的進展，密碼學已經從一個為了達成特定目的所開發的技術轉變成一門富有嚴謹理論基礎的科學。本課程並將會教授以下密碼學的方向，其主要目的是激起學生對密碼學的興趣，並培育密碼學人才。 1. 定義：探討如何明確且清楚的定義密碼學問題(又稱密碼概念)，以及量化所謂的安全性於不同的密碼概念上。 2. 密碼架構與安全性證明：將會介紹完整的密碼學架構，並且證明分析其架構安全性可以被某些困難的假設所保證。 3. 理論基礎：密碼架構都會接於困難假設，這部分將會介紹常用的困難假設，以及探討目前在理論以及實務上的發展。 4. 密碼應用：如何利用密碼架構應用在更高層的安全訴求上也是密碼學相當重要的課題。 5. 資訊安全：透過密碼學來實現網路安全或多媒體安全。

name.en: The earthquake-proof performance principle and the character

description.zh: 本課程將介紹現今用各種結構系統〔耐震、免震（隔震）、制震（減震）〕的特性及耐震性能原理，由基礎力學理論配合應用實務設計做一統括整理解說。並從地震中建築物實際破壞狀況的解說到耐震診斷及耐震補強技術做一現況的解說與說明。
description.en: The earthquake-proof performance principle and the characteristic of the structural system (1.General structure 2.Base isolation structure 3.Virbration control,Damper) being used well now are introduced at this course, and lectures from the mechanics theory of the base to a aactual design. In addition, the destruction situation and the earthquake-proof diagnosis reinforcement in the building are explained due to the earquake.

description.zh: 本課程以建築專業回應社會需求為依歸。針對台灣原住民部落之返鄉青年之居住與生產模式提出各項議題討論。藉由社區總體營造與民眾參與等方式，以一學期的進程發展新的部落建築形式與配置計畫，並在永續發展與保育並重的前提下，提出實質開發與營造施工的前期規劃。
description.en:
This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction for local social issues in Taiwan. In this year, Focuses on the Settlements of aboriginal people, through cases studies and design practice, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning. The topics also focus on six premises:1.theories in relation to site planning;2.design sequences of site planning;
3.investigations and analyses of the sites;4.planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5.environmental impact assessment and countermeasures.

description.zh: 施工歷史可以被視為了解建築理論的關鍵基礎。按照慣例，建築學院提供建築歷史方面的研究方面，包括建築風格和哲學的發展，或者建築材料和建築技術的最新進展。此外，關於建築的理論辯論也更加關注哲學的討論，而不是物理建築的表現。 但是，建築理論主要討論材料和建築系統的表示。因此，材料的構造方法實際上會極大地影響建築理論的解釋。因此，該課程可以分為兩個部分：首先，將回顧東西方世界的建設歷史以及現代時期。其次，將討論結構論和相對論的爭論。本課程的目的是發展與會學生的能力，使他們能夠回顧自己論點的要點，並運用適當的理論來支持或爭論他們對建築理論的理解。
description.en: Construction history could be considered as the key foundation to understand architectonic theories. Conventionally, architectural academies provide study aspects either in architectural histories in terms of development of architectural style and philosophy or in the latest progress of architectural materials and construction techniques. Moreover, theoretical debates of architecture also pay more attentions to philosophical discussions instead of physical construction presentation. Nevertheless, architectonic theories mainly discuss the presentation of materials and construction systems. Therefore, construction methods of materials in fact affect the interpretation of architectonic theories significantly. As a result, this course can be divided into two sections: firstly the construction history of Eastern and Western worlds as well as modern period of time will be reviewed. Secondly the architectonic and relative theoretic debates will be discussed.

In the first half of the courses, each participant has to find a project with vivid material expressions, which can be discussed in terms of tectonic theories and interpretations. The project can be international or domestic. It should be easier if the participant might find its design drawings. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.
＊＊Research thesis 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by the noon of 1/21 (12:00pm) to Dr. Wu in person. The words of the thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
Employed materials of one’s chosen architectural project for the thesis should be clarified. Please note that the referred theories should be reviewed firstly. Aftermath, the discussion of material deployment should be referred to at least one of the architectonic or atectonic theories.

description.zh: 一、 本課程目的在使同學認識與了解台灣傳統建築歷史、文化、技術之精髓所在，進而增進建築設計運用傳統建築思想與素材之能力。二、 講述內容包括台灣史前、原住民、荷西、明鄭、清代與近現代等建築之形成與型態變遷過程。三、 講述方式以幻燈片介紹為主，學期中並安排兩次實地參訪。

syllabi.outline: 本課程為大三（職二件四）以上修習傳統建築的專題課程。上課方式以演講為主，藉由文獻、圖片的介紹，概述台灣地區傳統建築的發展歷程，以及就其建築類型，概述其形式的社會文化根源。另外，配合傳統建築實例的參觀，期使同學除了對台灣住居文化的發展由來脈絡瞭解之外，並培養其對身處環境的關心與地方文化的涵養。

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods, implementing basic numerical methods using the MATLAB structured programming environment, and utilizing more sophisticated numerical methods provided as built-in MATLAB functions.

description.zh: 材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en: Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure, its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure, their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity, electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain , dislocation theory, the formation and growth of nucleus, alloy phase theory, degree of freedom of crystal boundary , nucleation and homogenization of casting product, hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

syllabi.outline: 物理冶金學乃是材料科學導論的延伸, 課程內容設計主要是讓學生能夠更深入地瞭解任何材料所呈現出來的最後性質/現象, 都是在材料的微觀結構中就已經決定, 在物理冶金(一)中, 我們主要會討論我們生活上最常面對到的(金屬), 金屬的機械性質好壞與否, 深深地影響了金屬的應用範圍,在討論材料機械性質之前, 我們需要從材料的微觀結構切入, 包含化學鍵結/原子堆積結構/缺陷等, 接著才開始藉由多方面的角度切入, 宏觀地討論材料最後所呈現出來的(機械)性質, 其中, 我們將會從物理冶金裡面最重要的差排理論出發, 從微觀的角度去探討宏觀實驗觀察到現象

description.zh: 本課程介紹X射線特性、繞射原理及X射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括X射線之產生，X射線之性質，X射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在X射線繞射方法方面則介紹Laue照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。

description.zh: 生醫製造是新穎的工程領域，是跨基礎科學與工程製造領域的實用科技，本課程專注於生醫製造方法的需求規範、製造原理的解說以及相關的新興領域的應用。在技術方面，生醫製造技術涉及積層製造技術、生物噴印技術、生醫材料、支架結構設計、細胞培養和動物實驗等相關知識。此課程也會說明斷層掃描影像重建人體模型的流程，支架內部孔隙設計對強度的影響，生物列印機的組裝技巧與規範，FDA對生物列印的規範，人工肉品的細胞培養與製造；另外，在應用於藥物開發方面，生醫製造學目前在再生醫學，藥物和組織工程等領域的應用案例說明，以及未來趨勢的分析與討論。
description.en: Biofabrication is a practical guide to the novel, inherently cross-disciplinary scientific field that focuses on biomanufacturing processes and a related range of emerging technologies. These processes and technologies ultimately further the development of products that may involve living (cells and/or tissues) and nonliving (bio-supportive proteins, scaffolds) components. The course introduces students to cell printing, patterning, assembling, 3D scaffold fabrication, cell/tissue-on-chips as a coherent micro-/nano-fabrication toolkit. Real-world examples illustrate how to apply biofabrication techniques in areas such as regenerative medicine, pharmaceuticals and tissue engineering.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Elements of ecosystems, biogeochemical cycling, environmental factor interactions, population dynamics, and community development. 

Course Goals 
This course is intended for students and will examine structure and function of ecological systems, including populations, communities, and ecosystems, role of evolution in structure and function of systems, and influence of society on the biosphere. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Understand major concepts and terminology in the field of ecology. 
2.	Identify reputable sources for ecological information. 
3.	Comprehend the methods and application of ecological research. 
4.	Evaluate human interactions with nature and effects on natural systems.

description.zh: 地質工程為一新興科學，原來為解決全球變遷等大尺度問題而提出。基本上可以土木及環境工程兩大方面。本課程將從地質背景出發，結合工程問題及其處理對策，提供學生一個整合性的思考及基礎的地質知能。
description.en: Geoengineering is planetary-scale environmental engineering, particularly engineering aimed at counteracting the undesired side effects of other human activities. Geoengineering covers a wide range of engineering disciplines related to geo-materials, such as foundation engineering, slope engineering, tunnelling, rock engineering, engineering geology and geo-environmental engineering. This course interests range from geological to geomorphological concept, to provide a firm fundamental background for the civil engineering and environmental engineering, and to manage and mitigate of natural hazards. Implicit in these pursuits is the stewardship of the earth, and the quest to harvest the most advanced fruits of scientific achievements as tools for our graduates to work with.

syllabi.outline:
生態系統為環境永續的根本。生態系統提供之自然資源與生態服務，也是人類社會中不可或缺的來源。本課程將使同學了解生態系統的運作，以及生態系統的各個組成，透過對生態系統的了解，未來在環境中所建構的各種設施，才能因應環境變化，且不破壞環境。本課程主要目的為在工程中學習與環境的互動，將環境生態因子納入工程建設設計與施作中，使未來硬體建設能更適應環境變異，提高韌性，成為環境所接受的工程。
Ecosystem is the foundation of the environmental sustainability. Ecosystem provides natural resources and ecological service, which are the major supplies for human system. This course is focus on the operation of ecosystem and the components. The understanding of ecosystem would be helpful to build the constructions that is resilient to variable environment and not bring damage to environment. The purpose of this course is to learn the interactions between engineering and environment, and to know how to incorporate ecological factors into engineering design and construction. The hard constructions with environmental considerations are expected to be accepted by the natural environment.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在提供修過基本統計課程的學生學習使用電腦軟體輔助進行統計分析的機會。R是目前最普遍使用的開放源碼統計軟體，也是在資料科學界裡，到目前為止最受歡迎的語言，若要挖掘大數據的祕密不可或缺，不但跨平台，而且有許多內建的統計函數、繪圖功能和自己的程式語言，對於幫助學生熟悉統計概念和程式設計，以便將來工作就業和進行研究都有不可或缺的幫助，是一套值得學習的工具軟體。本課程將涵蓋R程式的下載安裝、操作介面、繪圖指令、四則和函數運算、套件和程式開發、資料分析及統計應用等，修課學生需要曾經修過一門統計課程。
description.en: The goal of this course is to teach students how to use the open source software R for statistical analysis. R is currently the most commonly used free, open source, and cross-platform statistical software. It has many statistical functions, graphing tools, and its own programming language. Because of its many potential applications, the familiarity of this software could help students in the pursue of their chosen career paths, whether in industries or academic researches. This course will cover the various aspect of R, including installation, operation, data analysis, and program development. An entry-level statistical course is required before taking this course.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims at providing a learning opportunity to use MATLAB programs to solve statistical analysis problems. MATLAB is one of the common mathematic analysis software and a very popular language in data mining. Its multidisciplinary platform function and built-in orders for statistic calculation and drawings can literally be powerful for statistics learning. In this semester, the schedule includes basic MATLAB practices, engineering statistics, associate practice examples, problems involving extreme value analysis, and problems involving reliability analysis.

name.en: Cultural Medium Intervening into Urban Design

description.zh: 「媒介與環境」作為近年逐漸開始發展的學術領域，其論述原點通常可追溯自1960年代，藉由Marshall McLuhan對於媒體（Media）與媒介（Medium）的哲學性討論與實驗性創作，首先打開後世電影與媒體學者對於相關學術主題的探討。但這個概念卻要一直到近年，伴隨著科技的進步與媒體研究的發展，例如Anne Friedberg針對當代可以出現在各種人造與非人造環境中的螢幕（Screen）的分析，才被廣泛地作為媒介（Medium）與環境（environment）研究仰賴的分析架構，並奠定後續此學術領域的發展方向。此課程將於都市文化研究的固有知識基礎上，引入媒介與環境領域的新興論述，探究各類「觸媒」對於當代文化發展與都市設計的影響。探討子題包含有數位全球化、文創嘉年華、智慧城市、網飛經濟等當前重要都市發展議題，並透過課堂討論、方法學作業，與期末短論培養學生連結理論與實務、深度反思、和獨立探索新興學術領域的能力。
description.en: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges and scholars in film and media have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. syllabi.outline: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges. Scholars in both urban studies and media studies have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. Because of this, the studies of medium and environment has recently been an emerging field that intends to examine the phenomena intertwining the two aspects through interdisciplinary approach. Based on this background, this course will introduce cutting-edge scholarships of medium and environment studies to the traditional field of urban cultural studies, pursuing effective perspectives to unfold today’s critical urban issues, for instance globalization in digital era, the popularity of carnival and creative industries, smart and resilient city, Netflix economy/urbanism (Harvey, 2020), and so forth. Student will be expected to learn how to bridge theories and practices, to develop ability of critical thinking, and to learn corresponding methodologies.

name.zh: 文化觸媒介入都市設計
name.en: Cultural Medium Intervening into Urban Design

description.zh: 「媒介與環境」作為近年逐漸開始發展的學術領域，其論述原點通常可追溯自1960年代，藉由Marshall McLuhan對於媒體（Media）與媒介（Medium）的哲學性討論與實驗性創作，首先打開後世電影與媒體學者對於相關學術主題的探討。但這個概念卻要一直到近年，伴隨著科技的進步與媒體研究的發展，例如Anne Friedberg針對當代可以出現在各種人造與非人造環境中的螢幕（Screen）的分析，才被廣泛地作為媒介（Medium）與環境（environment）研究仰賴的分析架構，並奠定後續此學術領域的發展方向。此課程將於都市文化研究的固有知識基礎上，引入媒介與環境領域的新興論述，探究各類「觸媒」對於當代文化發展與都市設計的影響。探討子題包含有數位全球化、文創嘉年華、智慧城市、網飛經濟等當前重要都市發展議題，並透過課堂討論、方法學作業，與期末短論培養學生連結理論與實務、深度反思、和獨立探索新興學術領域的能力。
description.en: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges and scholars in film and media have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. Because of these, the studies of medium and environment has recently been an emerging field that intends to examine the phenomena intertwining the two aspects through interdisciplinary approach. syllabi.outline: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges. Scholars in both urban studies and media studies have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. Because of this, the studies of medium and environment has recently been an emerging field that intends to examine the phenomena intertwining the two aspects through interdisciplinary approach. Based on this background, this course will introduce cutting-edge scholarships of medium and environment studies to the traditional field of urban cultural studies, pursuing effective perspectives to unfold today’s critical urban issues, for instance globalization in digital era, the popularity of carnival and creative industries, smart and resilient city, Netflix economy/urbanism (Harvey, 2020), and so forth. Student will be expected to learn how to bridge theories and practices, to develop ability of critical thinking, and to learn corresponding methodologies.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用科學與系統化的方式解決管理上的問題。整個過程包括：資料蒐集與問題分析、數量模式的建構、問題求解、成本效益分析、系統規劃設計與執行等步驟。課程內容主要以應用案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，也會介紹最佳化計算軟體來求解數學模式並輔助說明所得數據之意涵。
description.en: The purpose of this course is talking about how to utilize scientific and systematical approaches to solve management problems. The solution process includes data collection and problem investigation, model formulation, optimal solution derivation, cost and efficiency analysis, system implementation and execution etc. This course mainly contains various application cases. Accordingly, participant can understand how to apply theoretical methods on solving real problems. Computational software is also utilized to solve the formulated models and analyze and interpret the obtained solutions.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於幫助學生瞭解財務決策的理論架構，主要著重於介紹財務管理的基本原理，以及其如何運用在財務經理所面對的主要決策上。希望學生於修習本課程後，能瞭解各種財務管理的工具，並能有效率地使用於投資與融資決策上。
description.en: This course is to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. The focus is on setting out the basic principles of financial management and applying them to the main decisions faced by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. It will focus on learning the fundamentals of financial management and applying for main decisions making while facing every day by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.

Course Goals and Learning Objectives:
1. Gaining financial experience/framework for students.
2. Understanding basic principles of financial management.
3. Applying knowledge to the Management Business Simulation. 
4. Roleplay as a CEO/CFO, students will apply various tools for financial management decisions.

By using an integrated Management Business simulation game as a major learning tool to illustrate how strategic and operational/financial decisions should be made in a competitive dynamic environment. So they will experience integrating and aligning key decision factors in different business scenarios. Simultaneously to achieve a set of defined performance objectives of a company by evaluating decision alternatives and tradeoffs for optimizing the resource utilization.

description.en: The goal of this course is to learn the basic tools and techniques required to implement Machine Vision on small, embedded, portable platforms. The primary focus will be on the design of industrial vision system based on specialized embedded hardware, with a little less focus on machine vision algorithm. The course will involve: (1) Linux embedded software development; (2) Qt GUI development; (3) development of embedded industrial machine vision algorithm; (4) application practice on the embedded platform, with an industrial camera, to demonstrate real time vision processing. The only pre-requisite for the course is to know C/C++ and image processing.

description.zh: 隨著人類對於工程技術的省思，以及環境倫理的變遷，兼顧生態、安全、景觀等面向生態工法逐漸受到重視。我國自2002年起，全力推動生態工法的落實及應用上的困難。有鑑於此，特開立「生態工法概論」，建立全盤性的了解，使土木工程能迎合時代的需求，提升相關智識水準。因此，將分別就基本精神、案例、應用範疇等議題進行探討。
description.en: This is intended as brief introduction to the subject of Ecological Engineering Methods(EEM), which is a whole new concept in the field of civil engineering. The Advantages of EEM is not only to satisfy the demand of safety(i.e. natural hazards control)but also that of protecting ecosystem and landscape aesthetic. In 2002, related government agencies try to pormote the application of EEM , and attempt to adopt this specific measure. However, the lack of basic understanding and knowledge has been the main reason why engineers are struggling in introducing EEM into reality. Therefore, including fundamental theories, cases study, and practical apects of application will be taught in this course. The optimal goal is to inspire students to learn more about new philosopgy and techniques in the world of civil engineering.

This is intended as brief introduction to the subject of Ecological Engineering Methods (EEM), which is a whole new concept in the field of civil engineering. The Advantages of EEM is not only to satisfy the demand of safety (i.e. natural hazards control) but also that of protecting ecosystem and landscape aesthetic. In 2002, related government agencies try to promote the application of EEM , and attempt to adopt this specific measure. However, the lack of basic understanding and knowledge has been the main reason why engineers are struggling in introducing EEM into reality. Therefore, including fundamental theories, cases study, and practical aspects of application will be taught in this course. The optimal goal is to inspire students to learn more about new philosophy and techniques in the world of civil engineering.

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

syllabi.outline: 隨著台灣農工社會、經濟型態的轉變以及對水資源安全供應之要求日益增加情況下，地下水與地表水聯合運用成為整體水資源經營管理不可或缺之一環。而超抽地下水造成之各項災害也與氣候變遷下複合型災害相連結。對地下水文進行更深入之探討，將裨益於解決各項地下水資源應用與防災相關問題。地下水的領域涵蓋水量,水質及防災三方面,修習此一學科，可以了解地下水水文及水力學之基本原理，進而掌握地下水水理與污染傳輸之特性,以作為規劃與管理地下水資源及防災之依據。

name.en: Special Topics on Geographical Information System

description.zh: 政府近年積極推動行政資訊化，應用資訊技術提昇行政的效率與品質，以達到便民及創新的效益。地理資訊系統(Geographical Information System，簡稱GIs)之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位在處理大量圖籍與相關文字資料之管理與查詢的最佳解決方案；配合完整中文介面與印表技術，更可提高效率資訊服務。國內各重大工程在規劃設計時，正逐漸引用地理資訊系統。以其強大之資訊處理、整合、分析、及展示等功能輔助，如圖籍疊合與環框分析等，使工程規劃設計更為準確客觀，發揮工程最大效益。
description.en: To provide public service with better quality, the administration of government with information-based is widely established by adopting newly developed information technology.  Geographic Information System is one of the technology especially applicable when massive maps and attribute data are involved in management affairs.  It offers users a solution for information management and data query under a graphic environment with Chinese interface as well as output printing specification.  The planning and design of major construction projects in Taiwan were increasingly referred to GIS for the reason that efficiency can be maximized by the powerful data organization, integration, and display capability along with GIS.

description.en: This is a comprehensive course in probability and statistics for students in engineering and technology discipline. This course will provide an opportunity to learn how probabilistic analysis and statistical reasoning and testing can be applied to a wide range of problems in civil engineering. description.zh: 本課程將探討明渠中穩定流、非穩定流、均勻流、非均勻流之流體特性。
description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure.  The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied).  For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

description.zh: 行銷英文是為商業人士及學習商業英語的學生而安排的一種多位階的商業英文課程。課程教本已經與世界領先企業資源之一的美國"經濟時代"期刊合作完成。課程單元都是為了讓學生具備好的工具和應用技巧以便他們可以在國際企業和行銷上有成功的表現而設計。課程結束後，學生將有能力在全面的商業環境下用英文去充分的溝通;能夠在商業的世界中去發揮他們的知識，更流利而且有自信的運用商業語言，進而增加他們服務公司的繁榮與發展。
description.en: Marketing English is a multi-level business English course for businesspeople and students of business English. The course book has been developed in association with the Financial Times, one of the leading sources of business information in the world. The units are designed to equip students with the tools and skills they need to succeed in marketing and international business. At the end of this course, students will be able to communicate in English in a wide range of business situations; they will also enlarge their knowledge of the business world; and they will be more fluent and confident in using the language of business and should increase their companies’ prospects.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Talk about your career plan
(1.) Ability, requests and offers. Telephoning: making contact. 
(2.) Listening and reading (videos and audio): An interview with the finance director of a tv company, and the effect of Facebook profile on your job prospect. 
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 2: Presenting your company
(1.) Describing companies. Presenting your company. 
(2.) Listening and reading (videos and audio): An interview with a CEO company.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 3: Negotiating skills
(1.) Making sales Negotiating: reaching agreement. 
(2.) Listening and reading: Interview with the director of a marketing company and the role of gender in marketing.  
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 4: What makes a great idea?
(1.) Successful meetings 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with a researcher. Web articles: Who needs translators? –; Safer cycling; Going for gold.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout. Discuss Final Paper

Week 5: Preparing for an Interview
(1.) Participating in discussions 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with the Director of Marketing at a health consultancy. 

*Assignments: Read the book and handout.
Week 6: Socializing with business partners
(1.) Socializing: greetings and small talk 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with the Chief Executive of a corporate entertainment company.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 7: New business and business sectors
(1.) Dealing with numbers. 
(2.) Listening and reading: Interviews with the CEO of a money-transfer company and the CEO of a food company.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.
Week 8: Marketing mix and marketing campaigns
(1.) Telephoning: exchanging information 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with the European Marketing manager of a pharmaceutical company.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 9: Midterm Oral Presentations

Week 10: Qualities of a good manager
(1.) Verbs and prepositions. Reported speech. Socializing and entertaining. 
(2.) Listening and reading: We will discuss an interview with the author of a management book.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 11: Managing conflicts
(1.) Word-building. Conditionals. Negotiating: dealing with conflict. 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with an expert in dispute resolution.
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 12: Presenting a product
(1.) Describing products.  Presenting a product. 
(2.) Listening and reading: An interview with the editor of a news network. 
*Assignments: Read the book and handout.

Week 13: Competition
We will discuss different scenarios in marketing transactions.
Readings: read the book and handout, videos and audio 

Week 14: Advertising and promotion
We will learn how to present an idea to colleagues or associates and persuade them to support the proposal.
Focus: listening comprehension, vocabulary, and speaking

Week 15: Branding
We will discuss famous brands and learn key branding vocabulary.
Focus: listening activity on branding
Assignments: Turn in Final Paper

Week 16: Case study 1
We will learn useful vocabulary for talking about competition in business.
Focus: listen to talks about rivalries, learn collocations with the word ‘competition’ and study competition idioms.

Week 17: Case study 2
We will learn useful words and phrases for talking about advertising methods and promotional strategies.
Focus: Role plays

Week 18: Final Exam Written Presentations
