description.zh: 倫理學(Ethics)是討論「應不應該」的一門哲學分支。倫理學可分為「微觀倫理學」：探討個人性之行為的應不應該的問題，以及「宏觀的倫理學」：探討整個社會的政治、經濟、法律、社會等方面的問題。倫理學亦可區分為「規範倫理學」及「應用倫理學」兩大類，前者探討善的定義與判斷準則、動機論與結果論、人的意志是否自由、決定論與責任、自律與他律、幸福與快樂、哪些德行(virtue)值得追求等等課題，後者則是運用倫理學觀點探討諸如安樂死、墮胎、環保、複製人等種種課題。本課程主要目的是在對倫理學課題與種類作一個基本的介紹，訓練及培養學生在倫理問題上思考的能力，期能讓學生在作道德問題的判斷與抉擇上能夠有所進步。
description.en: This course will introduce basic ideas of Ethics to students. The topics will include: the definition and criterion of good, motivation and consequence, the problem of free will, determinism and responsibility, autonomy and discipline by others, happiness and pleasure, and virtues. This course will also touch upon those issues in applied Ethics, such as abortion, environment, business ethics, death sentence, etc.

syllabi.outline:
倫理學(Ethics)是哲學的一個分支，探討與道德相關的一切問題的學問，道德是指人應該遵從的行為規範，也可以稱為道德哲學。
西方倫理學的發展可區分為「規範倫理學」、「後設倫理學」及「應用倫理學」三大類。「規範倫理學」探討善的定義與判斷準則、動機論與結果論、自律與他律、幸福與快樂等等課題。「後設倫理學」以語言分析方法釐清道德語言的意義。「應用倫理學」則是運用倫理學觀點探討諸如安樂死、墮胎、環保、基因科技等種種倫理問題。
由於倫理學作為一門通識課程，其學習旨趣並非理論導向，更多是應用導向，因此本課程之設計，將結合實際問題之思考與理論學習，培養同學在倫理問題上的思考能力，期能讓學生具有道德判斷與抉擇的基礎知識與基本能力。

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。

第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function.  But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine.  So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out.  One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts.  We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students,  and not all sick.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

name.zh: 科技新創事業與行銷策略
name.en: Technology Innovation Business and Marketing Strategy

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以科技新創事業的發展為目標，品牌的價值最大化為核心，進而設計與執行品牌之行銷方案，分析如何經營新創品牌的價值，與創造出在新創產業中的優勢品牌與品牌資產。結合行銷學的STP模型與SMART Strategy(睿智策略)，對本地與國際市場上的目標顧客，進行系統化的策略性行銷，連結顧客，經營通路上的成員與學習通路之設計，經由團隊合作，建構起良善通路的競爭優勢。本課程的教學模式，採用國立臺北科大經典的黑手工程師訓練模式，強調動手式的 OJT (On Job Training)。課堂上會有大量的實務型動手演練實作，下課後會有一定數量的作業與練習，透過此系統性訓練課程，將使學員(學生)具備微(小)型企業(工作室)的基本商業維運知識與能力。
description.en: The course is designed to target the development of Innovation Vocation, maximize the value of the brand as the core, and then design and implementation of brand marketing programs, analysis of how to operate a new brand value, and create a cultural industry in the advantages of brand and brand equity. To combine with the STP model of marketing and SMART Strategy, the target customers in the international market, the systematic strategic marketing, linking customers, managing the members in the channel and learning the channel design method. Use teamwork spirit to build the competitive advantage in the commercial channel. The teaching mode of the course: using the Taipei Tech classic Practice-Engineer training model, emphasizing the hands-on OJT (On Job Training) method. There will be a large number of hands-on exercises in the classroom, and a number of homework and exercises. After this course, students will have the basic business model knowledge and ability of micro-enterprises.

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

name.zh: 科技新創事業與行銷策略
name.en: Technology Innovation Business and Marketing Strategy

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以科技新創事業的發展為目標，品牌的價值最大化為核心，進而設計與執行品牌之行銷方案，分析如何經營新創品牌的價值，與創造出在新創產業中的優勢品牌與品牌資產。結合行銷學的STP模型與SMART Strategy(睿智策略)，對本地與國際市場上的目標顧客，進行系統化的策略性行銷，連結顧客，經營通路上的成員與學習通路之設計，經由團隊合作，建構起良善通路的競爭優勢。本課程的教學模式，採用國立臺北科大經典的黑手工程師訓練模式，強調動手式的 OJT (On Job Training)。課堂上會有大量的實務型動手演練實作，下課後會有一定數量的作業與練習，透過此系統性訓練課程，將使學員(學生)具備微(小)型企業(工作室)的基本商業維運知識與能力。
description.en: The course is designed to target the development of Innovation Vocation, maximize the value of the brand as the core, and then design and implementation of brand marketing programs, analysis of how to operate a new brand value, and create a cultural industry in the advantages of brand and brand equity. To combine with the STP model of marketing and SMART Strategy, the target customers in the international market, the systematic strategic marketing, linking customers, managing the members in the channel and learning the channel design method. Use teamwork spirit to build the competitive advantage in the commercial channel. The teaching mode of the course: using the Taipei Tech classic Practice-Engineer training model, emphasizing the hands-on OJT (On Job Training) method. There will be a large number of hands-on exercises in the classroom, and a number of homework and exercises. After this course, students will have the basic business model knowledge and ability of micro-enterprises.

name.en: Overseas Management Practice and Cross-border Studies

description.zh: 本課程將安排學生組團由學院教授帶領到境外EMBA專班或國外（含中國大陸）大學交流學習，瞭解該國地域性的產業型態與國家經濟政策，另安排到當地企業廠商做實地觀摩與考察。返校後由領隊教授引導主持，進行綜合討論，學生必須在返台灣後一個月內提交心得報告及建議。
description.en: The course will arrange the student group led by the college professor to the overseas EMBA class or foreign (including mainland China) universities to study and learn about the country's regional industrial type and national economic policy. They will then conduct the tours of local businesses. Upon returning, a seminar, facilitated by the professors, will be held to exchange views and opinions. Students are required to submit a final report with recommendations within one month after their return to Taiwan.

description.zh:
企業常常是網路攻擊的主要目標，這門課程主旨在教育修課學生如何成功防禦常見的網路威脅並且確保自己的金融服務安全運作。
本課程首先提供網絡安全的總體描述，指導同學了解目前面臨網絡威脅風險的一些最重要的服務和技術。熟悉該主題後，您將根據案例研究和現實生活場景探索特定技術和威脅。隨著同學們學習模組的進展，將發現漏洞和錯誤（包括人為風險因素），從而獲得有關最新威脅的專家級視野。然後，同學們將探索有關如何實現資料和基礎架構保護的資訊。在總結模組中，同學們將獲得流程和配置的最新重大更新，以及與基於資訊技術的金融服務中的網絡安全研究和開發相關的重要細節。
在課程最後，同學們將接觸到並對未來資訊安全的技術有初步的了解，以及如何保護未來的金融服務與相關的基礎建設。
同學們將會學到：
?	了解企業所面臨之網路威脅
?	探索如何辨識攻擊者
?	呈現弱點評估、軟體測試、滲透測試
?	使用緩解技術與補救計畫捍衛自己的金融網路
?	實做加解密系統
?	了解人工智慧如何影響網路安全
description.en:
Enterprises have always been a target of cybercrime. This course teaches you how to successfully defend your system against common cyber threats, making sure your financial services are a step ahead in terms of security.
The course begins by providing an overall description of cybersecurity, guiding you through some of the most important services and technologies currently at risk from cyber threats. Once you have familiarized yourself with the topic, you will explore specific technologies and threats based on case studies and real-life scenarios. As you progress through the modules, you will discover vulnerabilities and bugs (including the human risk factor), gaining an expert-level view of the most recent threats. You'll then explore information on how you can achieve data and infrastructure protection. description.zh: 以講授刑法基本概念的犯罪論、罪數論及刑罰論為主軸；並輔以相關案例的檢討、分析，以使同學對於抽象的概念及學理，得以理解及適用。目的除在強化同學對維護個人、社會、國家等法益的體認外，亦在奠定學習刑法各論的基礎。
description.en: The course focuses on the introduction to the fundamental ideas of the criminal law such as the criminal theory, crime arithmetic and punishment theory. Many relevant cases are presented in the class for further discussion and analysis. The ultimate objective of the course is not only to enhance the students a deeper understanding of the rights granted to individuals, society and nations, but also to equip them with a wider knowledge base ready for a further studying on each specific section of the Criminal Law.

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

description.zh:
無論就量而言或就質而言，債編均為民法中最為重要之部分。本課程旨在向修課同學作民法債編之概括介紹，包括債編總論及債編各論。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：
一、民法債編之背景及理論
二、民法債編之解釋
三、民法債編於案例事實之適用
四、民法債編與民法其他部分及民事訴訟法之結合
參與本課程乃理解民法債編及民法整體之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en:
"Obligations" is the most important part of the Civil Law, not only in quantity but in quality. This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Obligations", including "General Provisions for Obligations" and "Kinds of Obligations". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 
1. Background and theories of "Obligations".
2. Interpretation of "Obligations".
3. Application of "Obligations" to the facts.
4. Combination of "Obligations", other parts of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.
Attending this course is the critical step to understanding "Obligations" and the Civil Law as a whole, and it benefits participants a lot.

description.zh: 本課程將以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程序後實體」原則先就「程序審查」部分介紹專利申請之程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件，先申請原則、發明單一性及優先權。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

description.zh: 民法總則介紹民法中的共通概念與基本原則，為整部民法以及所有法律的學習基礎。透過民法總則之學習，同學可以熟悉法律的思考模式及規範架構。本課程將以理論與實務並重方式協助同學學習。
description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law.  In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study.  Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm.  This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

description.zh: 網路資源運用是現代人生的一部份，但不當利用網路或為犯罪工具的例子屢見不鮮，本課程擬探討網路誹謗、網路色情、駭客攻擊以及網路交際的安全性等，期望在個案的討論中培養學生正確利用網路資源的觀念，進一步落實法治教育。
description.en: To use internet resources is already part of the life for every modern people; however, the cases of using internet as the criminal tool are not rare. Thus, this course is going to discuss the law issues that are spread out from the application of internet, which including: internet slander, internet pornography. Hacker attack and electronic bank, electronic shopping, electronic business. Hope we can help our students to develop the right conception to use internet resources through case study, and further more to carry out the law education.

description.en: This course provides an overview of AI and its role in business transformation. The purpose is to improve understanding of AI and being used in the industries. Finally, learning how to utilize AI as the source of competitive advantage.

description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en: The function of industrial design in the 21st century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs. Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs. The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助高階管理階層作決策。一般而言，這門課為商學課程中的課程主要協助學員們具有整合能力。學員不只是在策略管理中應活學活用，也融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課將幫助您學習、研讀個案和討論，這是此門課的目標。 1. 瞭解組織所處環境 2. 分析外部環境之時機和危機 3. 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 4. 探討企業不同層次之應對策略。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making at the top management level. Traditionally, this course has been the capstone course in the business program and is taught at the last year of study so that students can integrate functional area knowledge into a coherent one. Students are expected not only to learn a body of knowledge on strategic management, but also to synthesize economics, accounting, and marketing as an aid top management level decisions. We will use a combination of readings, case studies, and lectures to achieve the goals of the course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹有效研發/創新管理的概念、原則、與標準，這些概念、原則與標準將成為知識密集型的組織與企業的關鍵競爭優勢。本課程將介紹一些相關企業個案和練習活動，用以連結國家、產業和企業的研發或創新活動，並選定方法和工具進行有效的整合功能、企業業務、研發和創新活動。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the concepts, principles, and standards for effective R&D/innovation management that is becoming the critical competitive advantages for the knowledge-intensive organizations and firms. The course will introduce a number of related cases and exercises with a view to bridge the national, industrial and corporate R&D/innovation activities, along with the presentation of selected approaches, methods and tools to effectively integrate functional, business and corporate R&D and innovation activities as a whole.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to provide an essential knowledge about the mechanical behavior and design of critical members of a building frame. Main focus will be placed on beam, column, and beam-column joint for their flexure, shear, bond, and anchorage behaviors. Besides, state-of-the-art research about the deteriorated hysteresis behavior and damage evaluation of reinforced concrete columns will be presented.

description.zh: 本課程論述工業生產演進與全球綠色設計方法、趨勢，以及規範與法規需求，定義出創新、高品質和優秀的設計。引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，藉以奠定我國未來勞動力市場的循環建築創新能量。
description.en: This course discusses the evolution of industrial production and global green design methods and trends, as well as the requirements of regulations and regulations, and defines innovation, high quality and excellent design. Guide students to study in multiple fields, and put forward the concept of environmental, social and economic balance in architectural design, so as to lay the energy of circular architectural innovation in China's future labor market.

description.zh: 近百年是台灣政治、社會、經濟、文化劇烈變動的時代。從清季西洋勢力的大舉進入，清廷推動自強新政以應變；爾後台灣淪入殖民統治，在近代化及同化政策下台灣的變革更為迅速；而從台灣光復迄今，不論是經濟發展、政治民主、教育普及等等，使台灣進入已開發國家之林。這些變革與發展，是台灣民眾集體努力的總成績，但其間也有許多引領風騷的人物，他們分佈於各個不同的領域，歷史家對他們的評價或正或負，成就與貢獻的多寡也有爭議，不過透過這些人物事蹟的探討，可了解個人與群體、時代、環境的互動關係，也更能掌握近百年台灣史發展的脈絡。
description.en: Never has Taiwan experienced so big changes in politics, social structures, economics and cultural movements as in the last century. In Ching Dynasty, the Westernized power entered and the Ching court initiated innovative campaigns to work against; then Taiwan under the colonial rule by Japan, modernization  and colonialism changes Taiwan a lot ; in past half century KMT's rule has advanced such great deal in the fields of economic development, democracy and education as to stand among the developed countries. Though it is the collective efforts of the Taiwanese people that contribute to the alteration and development, there exist some of the outstanding figures in various fields, who might receive positive as well as negative comments from the historians and who might initiate a controversy concerning their contribution. This course explores the most influential individuals and the events that happen around, in the hope to understand the interaction between each of them and the groups

description.zh: 何謂法國文化？文化對法國人而言代表了生活，每一分每一秒法國人都在創造編織文化，生活的點點滴滴具體象徵法蘭西文化與民族特性。隨著歐盟的成立與運作，地域文化的發展，東西歐文化交流與非歐洲移民文化的包容，再加上法國文化政策以發展地方文化為標的，使得20世紀的法國文化有別於過去的面貌。本課程將不同主題以單元方式探討，學習者可由中認識、了解法國文化的多元、形成方式，進而分辨與其它文化的差異點。此外，學習者需要自備主題參與討論、探討。主題準備方式是以在既有的書面或官方網站資料中衍生個人創意與想像力。
description.en: What is French Culture? For the French people, culture represents daily life, every minute and second the French is creating and weaving their culture, thus strengthening the symbol of French Culture and its identity. With the establishment and development of the European Union, France underwent a phase of decentralization and immigration; greatly influencing and changing the visage of 20the century French culture from before. Therefore, this course aims to stimulate discussion of the chapters through different subjects. Through this method, the students will be able to recognize and understand more about the diversity and formation of French culture; in addition, they will be capable of telling the differences between French culture and other cultures. During this course, the students are required to choose a subject to discuss and research.

description.zh: 本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
description.en: The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

description.zh:
「時間學」是一門相當實際的課程，其目的在教導學瞭解時間的意義，提升時間使用的價值以善用時間，充實自己的生命與生活。
本課程內容提供時間理論相關的觀念與方法，希望同學於課程中，一方面從學中做，一方面從做中學，而達到「時間學」增進個人健康，促進人際關係，有效處理公私事宜的三大功能。
description.en:
"Time Science" is a very practical course and its purpose is to teach students the meaning of time with a view to increasing the value of time utility so as to make good use of time and enrich one's own life and living.
The contents of the course provide the concept and method relating to time ethic and hope students to learn and work so  that "Time Sciecne" may attain three major functions--increase personal physical and mental health, promote interpersonal relationship and effectively handle public/private affairs.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society.  According to  researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication.  The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values.  Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us.  This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers.  It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. 當前我們身處的社會，分工與網絡日益複雜，我們觀照世界的方式，也逐漸發展出與前幾個世代不同的樣貌。媒體現如今愈趨重要，不只是人們認識世界的介質，更經常試圖引領人們用特定視角理解社會。

description.zh: 病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
description.en: This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host, and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
Virus is between life and no-life substances. It is Invisible to the naked eye unless under an electron microscope. However, virus is existed everywhere and has a very close relationship with humans. 8% of the human genome comes from viruses. At present, the most difficult to solve infectious disease problem is caused by virus. Although the structure and composition seems simple, virus has evolved an extraordinary strategy for survival. Virology enable us to insight the structure and function of molecules, cells, and organisms. From studying virus, people has gained a lot of important knowledge and research tools, which help people solving disease problems. This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host,and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
音樂欣賞以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period

17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music.

18	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

指標對應授課內容: 科學家經過十幾年的研究發現，古典音樂是治癒身體與精神創痛的良藥，可提升心智。
音樂療法(Music Therapy，MT)在過去四十年來在不同臨床領域的應用一直受到重視。多項研究顯示古典音樂與現代音樂對人身心健康的差異。

另一方面, 許多台灣年輕學子對古典音樂歷史演進大多比較陌生. 藉由這堂課能引領學生探索經過時代洗鍊的西方藝術音樂

description.zh: 古蹟是人類歷史發展過程中所留下來的具體構造物，它是歷史的見證，也是文化的軌跡。在台灣發展史上從早期的原住民社會到漢人移民大量進入台灣，及十七世紀後歷經不同政權的統治，每個時期均留下不少的古蹟，這些古蹟是文化發展的具體證據，是了解台灣歷史與文化的最佳途徑，而透過古蹟的探索可進一步增進傳統的建築、藝術、民俗、文物等各方面的知識，使學生從中體會先民來台的艱辛與其生活的智慧，培育其珍視先民文物史蹟的情懷。
description.en: Historical sites are the concrete structures, left behind by the historical development of human beings. They are genuine witnesses of history and the cultural tracks as well. In the history of Taiwan, quite a few historical sites built in different phases remain existent: from the early aboriginal society via the big migration of the Hans to the various periods of sovereignty since 17th century. The sites turn out to be important evidence of cultural growth, the easiest access to the understanding of Taiwanese history and culture. A thorough explore into the historical sites helps a lot to broaden our knowledge in the conventional architectures, arts, folklore and cultural objects. This course also helps us to realize the hardships of life our forefathers encounter and the wisdom they acquire, in the hope to grow a better sense to treasure the past culture and the objects available to them.

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.outline:
課程大綱
1、課程簡介：憲法為一個之根本大法，實質的憲法精神更是法治國的體現。憲法一般雖定性為公法，惟其觸角及影響力更深入到每一個法律領域之中，不管是民法、刑法、行政法等領域，均與憲法息息相關，多需要透過憲法之角度來檢視其他法律的正當性與是否合憲性。故憲法之重要性，當然不言而喻。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺憲法於整個法律體系中之定位及地位。
側重近幾年來的重大憲法爭議，將從大法官會議解釋來探討同性婚之違憲與否、通姦除罪化之憲法觀點、罷權等之公民權行使、言論自由與憲法之保障及界線等等，建立法律學的嚴謹思維，培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一周：導論：憲法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二周：憲法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是憲法憲法在整個法律體系中的位置憲法的繼受法性質。
第三周：憲法發展史國外發展法我國發展史。
第四周：憲法的法律性質公法或私法？憲法普通法及憲法特別法
第四周：憲法與其他法律的關係（1）：憲法與民法（大法官會議解釋）憲法與刑法憲法與行政法/勞基法憲法與經濟法憲法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五周：外國憲法簡介（一）美國憲法
第六周：外國憲法簡介（二）德國憲法
第七周：我國憲法之基本結構（一）概論
第八周：我國憲法的基本結構（二）國體及人民基本權利。
第九周：基本權利（一）生命權、財產權。
第十周：基本權利（二）自由權。
第十一周：期中考。
第十二周：言論自由專論。
第十三周：憲法第22條之其他基本權利。
第十五周：憲法23條比例原則介紹（一）
第十六周：憲法23條比例原則之相關釋憲解釋。
第十七周：我國政府及三權分立
第十八周：總統
第十九周：行政院、立法院、司法院、監察院及考試院
第二十周：期末考

description.zh: 資訊法律課程將讓同學了解網路資訊社會中各層面的相關法律議題。本課程內容著重於各種網路法律問題，例如資訊安全、網路契約的訂定、網域名稱、數位化著作權、商標權，隱私權以及電腦犯罪種類及防治的介紹。另外，本課程也以個案方式，敘述電腦資訊的相關法律問題，並從中了解虛擬世界與現實世界的法律規範，同時測試自己是否具備足夠的資訊法律知識，能夠在快速變遷的資訊社會中立足與發展。
description.en: The course of Information Laws is designed for the students to familiarize such legal issues in most of the aspects available in the current world as information security, internet contracts, domain names, digital copy rights, trademark ownership, individual privacy and the genre & prevention in relation to computers. In addition, we discuss individual cases to further understand the nature of legal issues concerning computerized information. Hopefully, we learn the legal disciplines existent in the virtual and real worlds; besides, the students are supposed to equip themselves with sufficient legal knowledge so that they can survive and thus keep growing in the ever-changing information society.

description.zh: 本課程結合跨領域，從人文、藝術、音樂、設計、多媒體、金融，到生物、醫學、材料、電資、工程…等各領域，導入如何利用人工智慧，加上量子計算應用到各層面上，以解決問題到科技研發創新。再介紹元宇宙的概念，然後結合各領域逐步完成元宇宙生態系的構建。
description.en: This course combines cross-fields, from humanities, art, music, design, multimedia, finance, to biology, medicine, materials, electricity, engineering... and other fields. Introduces how to use artificial intelligence and the application of quantum computing to solve problems and scientific innovation. Then introduce the concept of metaverse and gradually complete the construction of metaverse ecosystem.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
音樂欣賞以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Exam.	

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period

17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music.

18	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

課程名稱：音樂欣賞

課程對應指標：3. 健康福址; 4. 教育品質

指標對應授課內容: 科學家經過十幾年的研究發現，古典音樂是治癒身體與精神創痛的良藥，可提升心智。
音樂療法(Music Therapy，MT)在過去四十年來在不同臨床領域的應用一直受到重視。多項研究顯示古典音樂與現代音樂對人身心健康的差異。

另一方面, 許多台灣年輕學子對古典音樂歷史演進大多比較陌生. 藉由這堂課能引領學生探索經過時代洗鍊的西方藝術音樂

description.zh: 歷史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，不論是史料或新舊的研究著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為史學著作的經典。這些書籍既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，中西歷史、古往今來的風物民情、地貌變遷等流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解人類的歷史。
description.en: Since the study of the history has been in prosperity, a large number of historical texts have been newly translated and interpreted, thus gaining more importance. These texts can be categorized as classical volumes of history . There have been existent a lot of other written resources interesting and meaningful exhibiting the vivid image of the people, geography, folk stories and the transition of time available in history. This course focuses on these particular materials concerning the human history through the discussion of which, the history of mankind can be better understood.

syllabi.outline: 北科大歷史悠久，校史上溯日本時代，工程與科技專業教育備受肯定。本課程【歷史名著選讀】規劃閱讀台灣史、日本史以及台日關係史的經典名著，希望讓學生能透過連結這塊土地的戰前戰後的歷史，養成立足當下，關懷台灣社會、拓展亞洲與世界的視野。除了教導學生基本歷史知識素養，亦隨時補充時事與歷史發展的關聯，讓靜態的史學閱讀更生動活潑，感受更多史學知識的實用性。

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh: 資訊法律課程將讓同學了解網路資訊社會中各層面的相關法律議題。本課程內容著重於各種網路法律問題，例如資訊安全、網路契約的訂定、網域名稱、數位化著作權、商標權，隱私權以及電腦犯罪種類及防治的介紹。另外，本課程也以個案方式，敘述電腦資訊的相關法律問題，並從中了解虛擬世界與現實世界的法律規範，同時測試自己是否具備足夠的資訊法律知識，能夠在快速變遷的資訊社會中立足與發展。
description.en: The course of Information Laws is designed for the students to familiarize such legal issues in most of the aspects available in the current world as information security, internet contracts, domain names, digital copy rights, trademark ownership, individual privacy and the genre & prevention in relation to computers. In addition, we discuss individual cases to further understand the nature of legal issues concerning computerized information. Hopefully, we learn the legal disciplines existent in the virtual and real worlds; besides, the students are supposed to equip themselves with sufficient legal knowledge so that they can survive and thus keep growing in the ever-changing information society.

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

syllabi.outline: 以攝影來進行社會介入的作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成了越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。圍繞著攝影與社會這個主軸，本課程以結合攝影史和社會學知識領域的方式，來講述不同攝影類型，以及如何以影像來表現其社會性的思考。除此之外，本課程也將引導同學透過個人與團體作業練習和評圖過程，進入當代攝影創作與社會參與的對話。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 本課程之目的在使同學對於創業財務管理之專業知識產生一概略的認識，期望同學能瞭解資金之運用、籌措及管理之一些觀念及技巧，並做為未來進行相關財務決策或進一步研究財務理論之基礎。本課程會將攸關財務的主題加以介紹,包含：1.財務報表分析2.時間價值，債券與股票3.投資決策與折現分析4.風險、報酬與資金成本5.公司融資政策6.資本結構與股利政策7.財務規畫8.合併與購併。

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生成為具有深度文化視覺的科技人。從認識本土文化為起點，進而認識世界文化。引導學生如何探究文化現象，並且深入文化的精神境界，物質境界，瞭解文化價值與文化傳統，讓文化觀點充分融入個人的思維內涵。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to develop the cultural cultivation of our technology majored students. Starting with the culture of our own land and extending to world-wide culture. The teachers would guide the students to explore the phenomena of the culture, and try to find out both the spirit and the material of the culture. Through the understanding of the worth and the tradition of the culture, the students might merge the cultural cultivation into their personal thinking.

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

是以建構多元認知及探討，正是拓展知識廣度的重要方法。
本講座課程係以「單一主題」統領「多面知識」的方式進行授課。課程領域為社會科學，由六至八個相關單元組成，不同專家學者授課。除課堂授課外，得實行「實地體驗教學」，安排參觀與實習。
description.en: "Erudition & Refinement" is among the most essential in the field of General Education. "Erudition" refers to the width of knowledge-also a very important approach in enriching human experience by building multi-dimensional recognition of culture. The Lecture focuses on a "single theme" through the teaching/learning of "a diversity of knowledge. The course areas cover social science. The lecture will consist of six to eight units, which will be taught by different experts and scholars. In addition to the classroom teaching, there may also be "Experiencing Teaching On the Spot"-or rather, a visit to the location in question or practicum.

description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指20~35歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。

Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses.

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1)自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2)自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言, 本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知, 使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

syllabi.outline: 生態與自然保育是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解自然資源管理的架構，從而掌屋自然保育與生活品質的關係，再就台灣自然資源與環境管理問題，探究分析其根源，最後以自身潛力與未來方向為基礎，發想共同之願景。

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
課程結構與規劃：以藝術欣賞的形式為課程的主要架構，.內容包括中西名家繪畫與藝術品欣賞、中國文字之美、台灣美術欣賞、台灣生態、原住民藝術，建築與雕塑之美及國際性的藝術博覽會，如義大利威尼斯雙年展(La Biennale di Venezia)，香港的Art  Basel 等。課程內容規劃結合藝術欣賞與藝術概論，並融合藝術與生活、藝術與社會、藝術與歷史、藝術與宗教、藝術與人文關懷、藝術與設計和藝術與生態環境之間的交相連結所造成的多元關係。
課程目標與期許：
培養敏銳的觀察力及繪畫欣賞的素養和對藝術的喜愛及推廣；藉由報告及校外參觀的形式，提供「在旅行中發現文化、在旅行中發現藝術」的學習機會，親身經歷及探尋週遭的在地文化，認識和欣賞是關心和行動的開始，啟發關懷社會、關懷自然環境、愛鄉、愛國之情操。藝術不惟形而上只是少數人的範疇，應該走入社會、大眾化、生活化，並有啟示成教化、助人倫之功效，期望參與的學生能具有多元視野的藝術觀。

description.zh: 歷史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，不論是史料或新舊的研究著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為史學著作的經典。這些書籍既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，中西歷史、古往今來的風物民情、地貌變遷等流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解人類的歷史。
description.en: Since the study of the history has been in prosperity, a large number of historical texts have been newly translated and interpreted, thus gaining more importance. These texts can be categorized as classical volumes of history . There have been existent a lot of other written resources interesting and meaningful exhibiting the vivid image of the people, geography, folk stories and the transition of time available in history. This course focuses on these particular materials concerning the human history through the discussion of which, the history of mankind can be better understood.

syllabi.outline: 北科大歷史悠久，校史上溯日本時代，工程與科技專業教育備受肯定。本課程【歷史名著選讀】規劃閱讀台灣史、日本史以及台日關係史的經典名著，希望讓學生能透過連結這塊土地的戰前戰後的歷史，養成立足當下，關懷台灣社會、拓展亞洲與世界的視野。除了教導學生基本歷史知識素養，亦隨時補充時事與歷史發展的關聯，讓靜態的史學閱讀更生動活潑，感受更多史學知識的實用性。

description.zh:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

description.zh: 人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。
description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

name.zh: 勞動影像與當代台灣社會
name.en: Labor Images in Contemporary Taiwan Society

description.zh: 本課程與台北市勞動局合作，以歷年來勞動金像獎獲獎作品以及勞動局推出的勞動紀錄片為主要影像教材，從勞動社會學的觀點出發，對當代台灣社會的勞動相關議題進行介紹。課程涵蓋範圍兼顧理論與實務，除了以影片來進行課程講授與集體討論外，並指導同學以拍攝短片的方式，於學期末呈現他們對於日常生活裡的勞動議題觀察。
description.en: This course is intended to employ the award-winning works of the "Labor Awards" and the "Labor Documentary" launched by the Department of Labor, Taipei City Government over the years to introduce labor-related issues in Taiwan society from the perspectives of labor sociology. In cooperation with the Department of Labor, teaching with film and collective discussion constitute the main methods in this course which covers both the theory and the practice dimensions. In addition, students will be instructed to make a short film to present their observation on labor issues in daily life.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以(1)勞動與科技 (2)勞動與性別 (3)勞動文化遺產三個主題來闡述當代台灣社會的勞動課題。課程進行除透過相關勞動影片賞析與座談，進行上述課題的介紹與討論外，並將結合猴硐煤礦遺址的實地參訪，期以深化對台灣社會勞動歷史與文化的認識。

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 運動、營養與健康是目前先進國家相當關注之理念與課題，也是提升生活品質與開發個人潛能的有效方法。本課程將有系統的介紹健康的生活方式與規律適度的運動，並將著重於如何將運動學與營養學之學理與技術，適當應用於個體健康生活整體之營造，使修課學生能了解運動前後的均衡飲食與擁有健康。
description.en: Exercise, nutrition and health is very concerned about the idea of advanced countries and issues, but also an effective way to develop individual potential and quality of life improved. This course will introduce a healthy lifestyle with moderate exercise system of law, and will focus on how the theoretical and technical kinematics and nutrition, the proper individuals applied to create a healthy life as a whole, so that students can enjoy the sport taught , and have a healthy balanced diet.

name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
1、課程簡介：民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，但卻也是不好學的一門法律課程。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
2、課程目標及授課方式：
讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
上課時雖不會點名同學回答問題，但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論，以期收教學相長之效。
syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：民法課程基本介紹學習本課程之態度老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：什麼是法律/什麼是民法現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展民法在整個法律體系中的位置民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：公法與私法普通法及特別法實體法與程序法強行法與任意法固有法與繼受法國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係(1)：民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）民法與刑法民法與行政法/勞基法民法與經濟法民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係(2)-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：民法總則債篇總論債篇各論物權篇親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：土地法勞基法公寓大廈管理條例家庭暴力防治法智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh:
本課程講授媒體、企業與政治三者之間競合的互動關係，教你看透媒體新聞背後的意識形態、商業利益與政治操作。深入瞭解由傳統紙媒到當代電子媒體、網路媒體、各種新媒體通路中，大數據與內容的製作該如何結合運用。新聞媒體在企業與政治體系中的特殊角色與效應也是探討焦點。課程中將會針對海峽兩岸新聞媒體與綜藝節目製作做對比分析。
    本課程結合理論與實務導向的專題，以培養學生對當代傳播媒體現象與體制深入分析探究的能力;更引導學生具體認識在數位新媒體的時代中，如何利用新媒體來進行廣告、行銷、公關等實務操作的策略及步驟。
description.en: This course focuses on the interactive relationship between media, business, and politics, thereby helping students understand the political ideology, business interests, and political manipulation behind news and media events. The course also presents an in-depth analysis of the combination of big data and media content, in the complex production network of paper media, electronic media, internet media, and various other new media. The role and effects of news media in contemporary business and political establishments will also be explored. The course brings in a comparative and critical analysis of news and entertainment programming in both Taiwan and mainland China. This course combines theoretical framework and professional practice in order to cultivate the ability to intelligently analyze and explore the dynamics of various media phenomena and media institutions.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

name.zh: 二十世紀中國現代文學與文化建構
name.en: The modern literature and cultural construction in twentieth century China

description.zh: 本課程關注的焦點將以都市文學和民族/文化/現代建構為基底，以“五四”文學以來的總體概述為起始的一個發現之旅。課程將以夏志清的中國現代小說史為起點，進而以李歐梵對於民國初年出版商和作家和他們的貢獻作為對照，來做為現代城市文化風景的呈現。課程中將以安德森”想像的共同體”為背景，解釋它被各種文化論述所引用的觀點，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於民族建構的貢獻。
description.en: We arrange the course that is based on urban literatures, with issues about the race, culture and the construction of the modern world. The students in the course will be guided into a tour of discovery, which is summed up and initiated from “May 4th Movement”. The progress of course will be mapped out from “A History of Modern Chinese Fiction” compiled by C. T. Hsia (夏志清), and then the analysis from Leo Lee, and other writers, will be compared to exhibit the style and features of modern urban literatures. According to the theory of “Imagined Communities” which is authored by B. Anderson, we will also explain the viewpoints from different cultures, and comment on the analyses to the race construction with varied points of view.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以華語譜系為視角，以中國現代文學的總體概述為起始，進行一場發現之旅。課程將以王德威的《哈佛新編中國現代文學史》為讀本，介紹王德威如何繼承夏志清的工作，呈現新格局、輻射的、「史蘊詩心」的中國文學史呈現。課程中將著重介紹魯迅、張愛玲的文學地位，解釋他們在文學系譜上承前啟後的位置，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於當代文化建構的貢獻。
This course adapts a genealogy perspective and begins with a general overview of modern Chinese literature as a journey of discovery. The course will start with a introduction of A new literary history of modern China edited by Wang David Der-wei Wang (王德威), and then review how Wang succeeded Chih-tsing Hsia’s (夏志清)   work to present a new, diversify, and historically poetic version of Chinese literature history. This course will take these authors as cases for discussion, mapping Lu Hsun (魯迅)and Eileen Chang (張愛玲).With further navigating their positions in the literary genealogy, the lecturer aim to address how their literary works construct contemporary culture.

description.zh: 本課程旨在闡明中國傳統思想之精義，疏通其中所涵蘊之問題，希望透過講授與討論，把握中國思想發展之大脈，並展望未來文化之發展。在課程設計方面，依序分先秦諸子、魏晉玄學、隋唐佛學、宋明學、近代思想五大綱領。深入淺出，直探本源，使學者領會中國歷代哲人之睿見，指引人生步上光明之大道。
description.en: This course deals mainly with the essence of Chinese traditional thought, trying to sovle the riddles lying behind the msytery of Asian philosophy. Through lectures and class discussion, students are expected to have a better command of the significant stream of thinking development for the Chinese people and look into the future cultural development. As for the course planning, this course consists of the following five topics: Pre-Chin philosophers, Taoism in Wei and Jin Dynasties, Buddism in Sui and Tang dynasties, Confucianism in Song and Ming Dynasties and modern philosophy. The course will be presented with simple approaches and lots of class discussions in the hope that  students will realize the wisdom explored by important philosophers throughout Chinese history, which will in returen provide students with much more promising and enrihed way of life.

description.zh:
管理者必須具有優良的領導能力，才能成為優秀的管理者。本課程介紹領導理論、領導架構、權力應用及授權原則，領導者如何進行團隊領導、變革領導。並在組織內發生衝突時，如何進行衝突管理。在遇到部門內工作士氣低落時，如何激勵部屬以提升部屬士氣。並以相關領導個案進行討論，使學習者能模擬實務情形以學習如何領導。
對於理工科系人員，具有優良技術能力，在擔任主管之後能如能有良好的領導能力，即可成為一位卓越的主管。本課程為增強主管領導能力的重要課程之一。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to become good managers. This course introduces the leadership theory, leadership structure, authority application and principles of delegation, groups leading and transformational leadership. Also, this course covers the conflict management when conflict occurs in the group.Apart from that, the course also discuss about how to motivate subordinates to boost the morale of subordinates in the face of low morale in the department. The class uses relevant leader cases for discussion, for students to simulate practical situations in order to learn how to lead. 
For scientists and engineers with excellent technical abilities, will become an excellent supervisor, if they work as directors with good leadership skills. This course is one of the important courses to enhance the ability of competent leadership.

syllabi.outline:
*本課程為搭配大學社會責任計畫(「石碇永安茶香新源大學社會責任(USR)計畫」)執行之特色課程,修課者需要進行社會責任領導體驗作業,需大量密切的人際合作交流互動,歡迎對社會議題以及行動實踐有興趣之同學修習

USR課程的學習，是：
走出教室  拜訪城市
在城市探索城事
整座城市都是我們的教室
大學與地方同學共事
設法聚人成事
所有的城事都是我們可以學用知識的事

參與USR計畫，走入地方場域，隨時隨地都是學習。


人類是群居的動物，此等群性衍生出群育需求，也孕育出群體角色分化的社會生活。當多數人面臨相同問題，產生同樣需求時，人群會產生如何組織、領導，以匯集眾人成一體來群策群力的需求。
由此角度來看，「領導」是自我與他人在人際角色上的功能分化，人際互動過程中的主動方為領導者、被動方為受領導者。領導者需要主動積極的使人服從、促成合作，來達成彼此目的或是組織目標。
領導涉及運用說服能力、指揮行為、動用權力、發揮影響力等一連串的使他人趨向於與自己相一致目標效力的互動（interaction）歷程。領導他人之前先要領導自我，領導他人的奏效或出於人格感召、以身作則的榜樣，或透過利害影響他人行動抉擇，或是溝通協調、談判協商，並沒有固定有效的方法，僅有參考原則，面對實際情境如何領導需要權衡拿捏，難有標準答案，所以領導也可說是一種人際互動的藝術。
社會需要有領導者，來讓大眾群策群力的發展社會，而為社會培養未來的領導者，正是大學的使命之一。本課程講座研習、活動設計以及領導作業的實際操作，來體驗磨練同學的領導觀念與能力，同時將社會責任觀念帶給同學，引導同學觀察社會、關心社會、投入社會責任工作。
本課程為搭配北科大「石碇永安茶香新源大學社會責任(USR)計畫」之特色課程。USR工作的重點在影響周遭他人一起關心社會，投入社會服務，故除了系所專業之應實力外，也需要有人際相處、溝通協調等軟實力來支持。本於通識教育與系所教育搭配互補考量，特規劃領導概論課程來培訓學生協力USR計畫之執行，採小班(預計只收18位學生)實作教學，除有關領導力之主題觀念講解之外，將分組進行領導力體驗作業，規劃執行完成作業，帶回課堂進行深化討論並作成績評量。

description.zh: 唸社會哲學的主要原因在於，在社會的架構之內，從哲學的角度去探索一系列很根本的問題。它們包括﹕正義、公平、人權、自由、公民意識、市場與道德、科技與道德的關係等等。我們的探索是以哲學知識做為基礎，例如: 功利主義、康德的道德哲學、羅爾斯的正義理論，還有內格爾、多爾肯、與沈對公平理念的討論等等。由於這些問題與我們的福祉休戚相關，身為一個受過良好教育的社會公民，我們便需要具有社會哲學的知識。準此，我們可以了解社會是如何運作的，並且能夠對一些和我們個人利益乃至公共福祉相關的社會性議題進行反省，從而對它們做出正確的抉擇。
description.en: The main reason for studying Social Philosophy is that within the context of society, a number of fundamental questions can be answered from a philosophical perspective.  These include:  justice, equality, human rights, freedom, citizen consciousness, market and morality, and the relationship between technology and morality, etc. Furthermore, our investigation is based upon philosophical knowledge such as Utilitarianism, Kantian moral philosophy, John Rawls’ theory of justice, the debate of the idea of equality among Thomas Nagel, Ronald Dworkin, and Amartya Sen, etc.  Given these issues are directly relevant to our well-being and benefits, to be informed social citizens, we need to have knowledge of this subject.  Thus, we can know how the human society works, and being able to reflect upon these social issues that concern our personal interests and public welfare in an attempt of making good decisions for them.

syllabi.outline:
「社會」是指什麼？人的組合？人與物的組合？那麼發生的事件呢？各種政經制度、歷史、文化、信仰、道德、以及各種觀念呢？這些算不算在「社會」中？唯物的觀點只看到有形的物體，但是社會的組成中，還有許多非有形的事物在其中，是人類精神的產物，「社會」必然包物質和精神兩個部分。社會哲學研究的面向很廣，舉凡社會中的經濟、政治、文化現象都包含在社會哲學的研究對象中。
    本課程主要介紹批判主義社會學理論、人文主義社會學理論，以及社會正義理論三個主題。關於批判主義社會學理論主要介紹十九世紀馬克思（Karl Marx，1818-1883）的理論和二十世紀法蘭克福學派(the Frankfurt school)的「社會批判理論」（Critical Theory of Society）。關於人文主義社會學理論主要介紹十九世紀的韋伯(Max Weber, 1864~1920)的理論，以及法蘭克福學繼承韋伯的觀點所發展的理論。關於「社會正義」理論，則介紹在不同的政治倫理規範體系下的正義觀，分別是效益主義、自由主義、平等自由主義和社群主義。

description.zh: 在日常生活中經常會見到統計的應用，在讀取許多統計數據之時，我們必須要具有基本的統計概念才不會被數據所誤導。本課程利用 Excel 統計分析的功能，介紹基本的統計方法，藉由生活中應用之實例，將問卷設計、資料蒐集與分析、統計結果之解釋等，做一系列之介紹。
description.en: We usually use statistics in our daily life, but in many cases, we should have basic statistic concept, otherwise we maybe misleading by the data.  In this lesson, we use statistic analysis function of Excel as a useful tool.  Introduce basic method of statistic, show the procedure of questionnaire design, data collection and analysis, explanation of result etc., by use the example in our daily life.
