description.zh: 本課程通過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性。 本課程將閱讀及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件和趨勢，培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en:
This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調電資專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service Electrical Engineering and Computer Science students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

syllabi.outline:
因為很多人每天都在玩、看和討論體育，所以在與說英語的人互動時，能夠談論體育和理解體育成語是非常有幫助的。 本課程向學生介紹英語詞彙，這些詞彙對於談論體育運動很有用，但在其他社交場合也很有用。 （例如，許多體育習語——例如“to play hardball”和“to triterout”——被商人在與體育沒有直接關係的職業場合使用）。 該課程幫助學生更清楚地了解有關體育的英語新聞，與說英語的人更深思熟慮地談論體育，並更批判性地思考體育在英語中人們的文化、語言和日常生活中所扮演的重要角色—— 說話的世界。
Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports everyday, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations.  (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

English Description: 
This course aims to use latest and current news as teaching materials to help students build their vocabulary, familiarize themselves with basic sentence patterns and eventually develop their comprehension abilities. News reports suitable for basic-level students will be selected from newspapers or news magazines (e.g. bilingual news from China Post and Taipei Times) and online news websites (e.g. VOA Special English) to effectively enhance students’ fundamental reading skills.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹經濟學領域的英語用語，以及經濟學的基本概念與應用，使學生有能力理解與分析社會上的重要議題，包括自由市場的優勢、稅賦與市場機制，以及國際貿易競爭等。課堂討論的議題包括供需機制、市場、稅賦、國際貿易、收入等。另外也將討論分析個案與新聞報導，讓學生學習不同觀點，獲得靈感，並且能使用英語來討論與呈現相關社會議題。
description.en: This course will be devoted to introducing the use of English in the field of economics, as well as discussing fundamental ideas and their applications and policy, so that students will be capable of considering important issues facing the society: the advantages of a free society, taxation and its interference with the market mechanism, and competition in international trade. Some of the important topics to be covered include Supply and Demand, Markets, Taxation, International Trade, and Income. The analysis of case studies and news excerpts will not only allow them to gain new perspectives and greater insights concerning issues; hopefully, they will also acquire the ability to use English in the discussion and presentation of relevant current issues.

syllabi.outline: The first goal of this course is to engage students in the understanding and discussions on the current economic and trading issues on both global and regional scales. The second goal is to cultivate students’ full English skills, including listening, reading, speaking, writing, and interpreting/translating while exploring aforementioned global and regional economic/trading affairs.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline:
本課程欲讓學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

name.en: Financial Common Sense and Professional Ethics

description.zh: 為強化學生具備從事金融相關職業之金融市場常識與職業道德觀念，本課程內容涵蓋金融市場常識與金融市場從業人員職業道德兩部份。其中金融市場常識包括：金融體系基本結構、證券期貨市場、銀行實務、信託實務、貨幣市場實務、保險實務等基礎知識。此外，金融市場從業人員職業道德部份則以主管機關所訂相關規範為架構，介紹：業務推廣與招攬、受託執行業務、告知義務與通知、誠實信用原則、有關利益衝突、保密原則、遵守法律規範與自律等金融從業人員應有的職業道德課題。期望學生習得金融市場之基本專業知識，並體認金融從業人員應有的道德常識，以通過且取得「金融市場常識與職業道德」專業證照。
description.en: In order to strengthen students' knowledge of the financial market and professional ethics for engaging in finance-related occupations, this course covers two parts, the common sense of the financial market and the professional ethics of financial market practitioners. The common knowledge of financial market includes: the basic structure of the financial system, securities and futures market, banking practice, trust practice, money market practice, insurance practice and other basic knowledge. In addition, the professional ethics of financial market practitioners is based on the relevant norms set by the competent authorities, and introduces: business promotion and solicitation, entrusted business execution, disclosure obligations and notices, principles of good faith, relevant conflicts of interest, confidentiality principles, compliance with laws Professional ethics issues that financial practitioners should have, such as regulation and self-discipline. name.en: Foreign Exchange Markets: Theories and Practices

description.zh: 本課程教授內容包括外匯理論與實務操作，課程內容包括： 1. 探討有那些因素會影響匯率的波動以及均衡匯率的決定，並以實務案例，引導學生得以學習到外匯交易的知識，並懂得結合外匯交易的理論與實務來建置自己的外匯交易策略，進行正確的外匯投資操作。2. 透過對外匯市場交易之思考、探討、批判與洞察，來打造最適合的外匯交易策略，進而提升外匯專業之操作能力。
description.en: This course prepares students to effectively analyze, assess, and trade foreign currency in the FOREX spot market. Topics presented during the course include: models of success and historical evidence on buying and selling patterns, how to understand volatility of return on the foreign currency exchange, the price behavior of currency, and technical tools for analysis including Japanese Candlesticks and Bar charts. The course focuses on foreign exchange market, major players in the FOREX market, spot and forward market, currency futures and options, foreign exchange exposure and risk, FOREX traders and trading, technical analysis in the FOREX market, profiles of the world’s major currencies and their characteristics. description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將教導學生解決衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題的方法。這些方法會需要一些基礎的數學工具，例如微積分與統計，而這些工具大一、二的學生在過往的必修課程中已經習得。為了有效處理複雜的評價問題並與所介紹的基礎觀念連結，本課程將會教導學生如何利用兩種程式語言，C 和 Matlab，來進行計算，處理的問題也將包含 (1)現金流現值的計算，(2)利用牛頓法求解公司債持有報酬率，(3) 利用二分法計算swap interest rate (4) 拔靴法求零息利率

(This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will then be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the calculation of the present value of future cash flows, internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  
and zero rate curves via the bootstrap method.)

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹數位金融理論以及介紹代表性的實務案例，課程中除了學習數位金融及人工智慧專業知識外，並結合實作來了解如何應用APP及聊天機器人於智慧金融及金融行銷等領域。在實作過程中，將鏈結進駐金融科技創新園區金融機構及新創公司所有業師資源，共同創建教學大綱和案例研究，並導入業師進行課程教學或講座或協同教學 (Co-teaching)，在授課過程中，學生不僅可以學習到APP的應用程式開發以及最有系統的方式學會如何設計並建立一支經過用戶體驗設計（介面設計與互動設計）的Chatbot，同時教導學生如何透過實證場域驗證進行串接API，發想創意，鼓勵金融創新實證之共創生態發展、降低金融科技創新實證門檻、同時兼顧創新風險控管與不影響市場運作機制，並將科技導入進行創新創業。課程內容包括：創業思維、設計思考、數位金融創新商業模式、無現金社會新興平台與行動支付的發展趨勢、保險科技 (InsurTech) 的應用及發展趨勢、籌資模式演進與P2P 貸款、金融科技的新興資訊工具應用發展趨勢、虛擬貨幣與區塊鏈專題探討、及機器人理財與AI的創新應用等，並探討數位新科技與人工智慧發展對金融產業衝擊、新典範的反思與影響。
description.en: This course will provide students with the latest empowering and practical knowledge on Digital Finance enabling them to understand some of the FinTech changes taking place currently in the financial services industry and, most importantly, the trends that will impact the industry in the future. The course content will include peer to peer lending platforms and crowdfunding, internet finance, online finance, bitcoin, digital currencies, digital payments, big data, insurtech, machine learning and its applications in FinTech such as robo-advising. etc. and their practical impact on global banking and finance.

教學進度規劃如下：

1. 課程主題：金融科技的發展演進
課程內容包括：金融科技之起源與發展、金融科技對傳統金融業之衝擊、國際銀行業金融科技之因應趨勢、我國金融科技之發展政策、數位新科技對金融理論衝擊、新典範的反思與影響

2. 課程主題：雲端運算
課程內容包括：雲端運算的定義與特色、雲端運算的三大服務模式、雲端運算佈署的三種模型、雲端運算的應用、雲端運算的安全問題

3. 課程主題：大數據與新市場平台
課程內容包括：數據資料的基本單位、大數據的定義及特性、大數據資料類型、大數據資料分析的五步驟、金融業大數據應用方向、大數據發展的困難與挑戰、新市場平台

4. 課程主題：人工智慧
課程內容包括：人工智慧簡介、人工智慧於金融之應用發展、人工智慧的風險與挑戰、人工智慧發展對金融產業發展衝擊、反思與影響

5. 業師專題演講：互聯網金融創新模式發展與應用
課程內容包括：互聯網金融定義、互聯網金融的應用、互聯網金融的發展趨勢及應用案例

6. 課程主題：Blockchain(區塊鏈)的發展與應用
課程內容包括：區塊鏈定義、區塊鏈的形成、特性、制度類型、優點以及在金融上與商業上的應用

7. 課程主題：生物辨識技術
課程內容包括：生物辨識的緣起、生物辨識技術種類現況、導入何種最適生物辨識技術之評估、生物辨識在金融創新之運用現況與趨勢

8. 課程主題：保險科技創新模式及發展趨勢
課程內容包括：保險科技定義、保險科技簡介、保險科技之應用與發展、保險科技的影響與挑戰

9. 業師專題演講：金融科技園區Open API資源介紹、應用及串接實作
課程內容包括：金融科技園區Open API資源介紹、Open API應用案例、金融科技園區RESTful API串接實作等，並透過「數位沙盒」驗證環境試行國內第一個「場域限定」金融科技創新實證API數位共通環境

10.	課程主題：聊天機器人介面設計與AI 簡介(學生實作)
課程內容包括：什麼是人工智慧?人工智慧發展的歷史、聊天機器人介面設計、人工智慧應用與實作

11. 課程主題：聊天機器人於金融商品數位行銷之應用(學生實作)
課程內容包括：建置智能聊天機器人學生實作、數位行銷功能導入Line Bot應用

12. 業師共授與學生實作：聊天機器人串接 Open API應用工作坊
課程內容包括： Chatbot 建置與Open API串接、LINE Chatbot Open API 案例介紹、Jupyter實作

13. 業師共授與學生實作：APP製作與串接API之應用
課程內容包括：使用軟體Thunkable及APP Inventor資源介紹、APP製作及開發技巧、股市資料庫資料API之串接實作

14. 業師共授與學生實作：股市資訊查詢APP 之製作與開發
課程內容包括：股市資料查詢APP製作、選股APP介面開發及應用、APP上架Google Play商店實作

15. 課程主題：創新創業資源與創業計畫書之撰寫
課程內容包括：政府創新創業資源簡介、創業計劃書撰寫技巧、創業簡報架構

16. 課程主題：如何與投資人共創價值與專利佈局
課程內容包括：投資人的類型與屬性、募資計畫撰寫、新創估值評價方法、專利佈局實務簡介

description.zh: 本課程銜接上學期資金管理內容，將資金管理理論運用於實務金融市場、Blackjack 21點。包括最佳化比例、賽馬賭局、損益量化、最大回檔風險、槓桿空間模型、固定分數與固定比例的運用。建議具有基礎程式撰寫能力、先修習過演算法交易、資金管理..等課程。
description.en: This course connects the money management content of the previous semester, and applies the theory to the practical financial market and Blackjack 21 points. The course includes optimal bidding fraction, horse racing, profit quantification maximum draw-down risk, leverage space models, and the use of fixed fractions and fixed ratios. It is recommended to have the ability to write basic programs, and have taken courses such as algorithmic trading and money management in advance.

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將教導學生解決衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題的方法。這些方法會需要一些基礎的數學工具，例如微積分與統計，而這些工具大一、二的學生在過往的必修課程中已經習得。為了有效處理複雜的評價問題並與所介紹的基礎觀念連結，本課程將會教導學生如何利用兩種程式語言，C 和 Matlab，來進行計算，處理的問題也將包含 (1)現金流現值的計算，(2)利用牛頓法求解公司債持有報酬率，(3) 利用二分法計算swap interest rate (4) 拔靴法求零息利率

(This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will then be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the calculation of the present value of future cash flows, internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  
and zero rate curves via the bootstrap method.)

description.zh:
管理者必須具有優良的領導能力，才能成為優秀的管理者。本課程介紹領導理論、領導架構、權力應用及授權原則，領導者如何進行團隊領導、變革領導。並在組織內發生衝突時，如何進行衝突管理。在遇到部門內工作士氣低落時，如何激勵部屬以提升部屬士氣。並以相關領導個案進行討論，使學習者能模擬實務情形以學習如何領導。
對於理工科系人員，具有優良技術能力，在擔任主管之後能如能有良好的領導能力，即可成為一位卓越的主管。本課程為增強主管領導能力的重要課程之一。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to become good managers. This course introduces the leadership theory, leadership structure, authority application and principles of delegation, groups leading and transformational leadership. Also, this course covers the conflict management when conflict occurs in the group.Apart from that, the course also discuss about how to motivate subordinates to boost the morale of subordinates in the face of low morale in the department. The class uses relevant leader cases for discussion, for students to simulate practical situations in order to learn how to lead. 
For scientists and engineers with excellent technical abilities, will become an excellent supervisor, if they work as directors with good leadership skills. This course is one of the important courses to enhance the ability of competent leadership.

- Word counts: 2000-5000 (excluding references)
- Plagiarism check should be lower than 30%.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程導論、欣賞音樂的角度與方法 
第二週：中世紀音樂 - 音樂織體、教會調式、大小調性、葛利果聖歌、複音聖歌
第三週：文藝復興時期音樂 - 複音音樂、模仿對位、對位法概論；Lute Song 介紹（Green Sleeves 欣賞)；巴洛克早期 - Monterverdi（歌劇的誕生 Orfeo）
第四週：巴洛克早期音樂 - Lully 作品（La Roi Danse 電影介紹）
第五週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Henry Purcell (Dido und Aneas 歌劇介紹）、Bach
第六週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Handel （Farinelli 電影介紹）
第七週：古典時期音樂 - 功能和聲概論、Haydn, 單主題奏鳴曲
第八週：Mozart、非原調再現的奏鳴曲式 (Amadeus 電影介紹）
第九週：期中報告
第十週：Beethoven、動機發展、奏鳴曲式之材料運用、
第十一週：浪漫樂派 - Schubert、Chopin（Chopin - Desire for Love 電影介紹)
第十二週：浪漫樂派 - Schumann、Brahms（Beloved Clara 電影介紹）
第十三週：浪漫樂派 - Liszt（Song without End 電影介紹）, Wagner、Puccini （La Boheme 歌劇介紹） 
第十四週：印象樂派 - Debussy, Ravel
第十五週：現代音樂 - Schoenberg, Webern, Berg、電子音樂、頻譜主義 
第十六週：美國當代音樂劇 - 百老匯名曲賞析、變身怪醫、版本比較
第十七週：跨界音樂作曲家、歌手、歌曲介紹 - 李泰祥、齊豫（古典、民歌）、Sara Brightmen、迪瑪希、鄭雲龍、阿云嘎 （音樂劇、古典、流行歌）Úyanga Bold、薩頂頂 （民族音樂、流行歌）。期末報告。
第十八週：期末報告
syllabi.assessment:
期中報告、期末報告（60%）、課堂參與（40%）

報告方式：8 分鐘的音樂作品解析口頭報告與書面報告（每組至多 5 人），包含「期中前期企劃報告」，以及「期末口頭與書面報告」，期中、期末皆需需製作投影片。報告的焦點可以包含：作曲家簡介、作品靈感來源或創作背景、作品的曲式、作品風格、樂器使用、個人心得、演奏版本比較、靜態或動態之音樂視覺化呈現（例如：https://youtu.be/71hNl_skTZQ) 等。

name.zh: 科技產品市場定位與策略
name.en: Technology Products Market Positioning and Strategy

description.zh: 本課程在使學生藉由瞭解市場定位與策略跟科技產品發展與運用的領域有著密不可分的關係。課程內容主要藉由當前科技產品發展的相關課題，以及整體環境的概述，讓同學對於產業或企業之科技產品市場定位與策略有一基本的認知，提供同學從科技產品、市場定位、管理策略的不同角度瞭解科技產品於市場上定位及推動發展策略。
description.en: This course is closely related to the field of technology product development and application through understanding market positioning and strategies. The course content mainly provides students with a basic understanding of the market positioning and strategies of technology products in industries or enterprises through the current topics related to the development of technology products and an overview of the overall environment, and provides students with different perspectives on technology products, market positioning, and management strategies. Understand the positioning of technology products in the market and promote development strategies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要讓同學能理論與實務兼具，了解科技產品及服務在市場定位及策略，並快速在工作上即時運用課程設計。首先以全球化的市場觀點，及新科技的運用及發展，接著以企業自身之定位，去了解如何提供消費者及客戶之需求。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容，讓同學學習後，即時在工作上運用。
This course mainly enables students to have both theory and practice, understand the market positioning and strategies of technology products and services, and quickly apply course design at work. First of all, from the perspective of the global market, and the application and development of new technologies, and then from the positioning of the company itself, to understand how to meet the needs of consumers and customers. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with exercises and case studies as the main teaching content, so that students can apply them at work immediately after learning.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於如何應用計量方法來進行財金議題之研究，課程內容包括縱斷面資料分析、橫斷面資料分析、追蹤資料分析、以及多變量時間序列分析等，讓學生掌握有助於分析經濟和金融數據的計量經濟學學習方法的知識，培養同學具有應用計量軟體進行分析研究的能力。
description.en: The course is aimed to provide essential econometric methods and their application to research issues. Topics cover regression analysis using time-series data, cross-sectional data, and panel data. The multivariate time-series analysis is also introduced in the course. This course is designed to prepare students with knowledge of econometric methods that are useful for analyzing economic and financial data. Students will focus on learning econometric software skills in estimating and analyzing econometric models.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目標在於如何應用計量方法來進行財金議題之研究，課程內容包括縱斷面資料分析、橫斷面資料分析、追蹤資料分析、以及多變量時間序列分析等，讓學生掌握有助於分析經濟和金融數據的計量經濟學學習方法的知識，培養同學具有應用計量軟體進行分析研究的能力。
The course is aimed to provide essential econometric methods and their application to research issues. Topics cover regression analysis using time-series data, cross-sectional data, and panel data. The multivariate time-series analysis is also introduced in the course. This course is designed to prepare students with knowledge of econometric methods that are useful for analyzing economic and financial data. Students will focus on learning econometric software skills in estimating and analyzing econometric models.

description.zh: 雷射乃20世紀三大發明之一，醫用雷射更已廣泛地應用在各個醫學領域。本課程將涵蓋的範圍包括：1. 雷射基本原理；2. 雷射安全標準；3. 雷射與組織的作用關係；4. 雷射在醫學的各種應用；5. 雷射於牙周病的應用；6. 雷射於口腔外科的應用；7. 雷射應用於牙齒美白；8. 低能量雷射的各種應用；9. 雷射實機操作與臨床示範。

Practical Hands-on and Live Patient Demonstration.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

name.en: Special topics in Taiwan Traditional Architecture

description.zh: 台灣傳統建築史的研究已歷多年發展，累積了相當豐富的研究成果。本課程擬由傳統閩客建築類型所屬之空間文化進行研討，透過"環境與構造"、"儀式與空間"、"政治與建築"等進階專題研討，期待引領修課同學進入並體驗台灣傳統建築的深層特色與意涵，過程中除了相關文獻的閱讀，案例調查報告外，並由田野實地參觀，帶領同學感受台灣傳統閩客建築的獨特環境與空間文化。
description.en: The research of the history of Taiwanese traditional architecture has got a great achievement after many years of development. This course is focus on the spatial culture of different types of traditional Hakka and Fujian architecture. I hopes that every students could understand and experience the deep social cultural meanings and features through the study of following three issues :"environment and construction", "rite and space" and "politics and architecture".  This course would not only be proceeded by the reading of related documents and the reporting of different case, it also combined the field visiting and investment to lead students to enjoy the very special cultural heritage.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為台灣傳統建築文化系列課程之一，其主旨在介紹台灣傳統建築的理論與原則，藉由已有的研究案例與成果，使同學能擴展其對台灣傳統建築研究的視界，並就傳統建築中特定建築類型與空間文化議題進行研討，除了經由地方志等文獻的解讀，以了解建築所屬的特殊空間文化意涵外，並由同學進行特定建築的實地調查，以供印證。本課程期使修課同學除了對傳統建築的意義有所瞭解外，亦對特定建築類型的社會文化意義有所體認。
syllabi.schedule:
專題(一)：儀式空間
建築形式的呈現，乃諸多因子的綜合結果。對宗教建築空間而言，儀式空間乃是信仰中心和起源象徵化的具體表現，也是空間觀念由行為意圖跨至構築意圖的橋樑。本課程的設計，期使同學經由宗教學、人類學及建築學等跨領域學科理論與案例研究的對照，系統地認識神聖空間的組成及其要素，分就信仰、象徵及儀式行為的表徵進行討論，並透過各種儀式的現場觀察與介紹，以瞭解儀式空間作為解構建築文化的關鍵角色與應用可能。

□禁忌與象徵
3.	金澤（2002）《宗教禁忌研究》，北京：社會科學文獻出版社。第一章  宗教禁忌的起源（1-49）、第二章  宗教禁忌的性質（50-131）、第三章  宗教禁忌的功能（132-191）
4.	王銘銘（1997）〈神靈、象徵與儀式：民間宗教的文化理解〉《象徵與社會：中國民間文化的探討》，天津：人民。頁27-63。
□現象與空間
5.	王鏡玲（1991）《台灣廟宇建構儀式初探---以艾德良神聖空間建構的觀點》，東吳碩論。
6.	呂理政（1992）〈第三章  空間認知與宇宙意象〉《傳統信仰與現代社會》，台北：稻香。頁45-87。
7.	李亦園（1996）〈和諧與均衡：民間信仰中的宇宙詮釋〉《文化的圖像（下）》，台北：允辰。頁64-94。
8.	張 珣（1995）〈大甲媽祖進行儀式空間的階層性〉《空間、力與社會》，台北：中研院民族所。
9.	林會承（1990）〈台灣傳統家屋中的儀式行為及其間所隱含的家屋理念與空間觀〉《賀陳詞教授七秩壽慶論文集》，頁101-137。台北：詹氏書局。

□神聖空間
10.	張崑振，徐明福（1999）〈臺灣龍華派齋堂儀式空間之研究：齋堂神聖空間模型的建構〉《中央研究院民族學研究所集刊》第八十五期，頁53-111。
11.	潘朝陽（1995）〈「中心-四方」空間形成及其宇宙論結構〉《師大地理研究報告》，23期，頁83-107
12.	林會承（1995）〈漢民族空間模型之建立概說〉《賀陳詞教授紀念文集》，頁89-117。東海大學建築系。
13.	潘桂成（1995）〈儒學空間之理論與實踐〉《師大地理研究報告》，24期，頁97-118。

專題(二)：儒學與建築
□儒家制度

	第六章〈明朝的書院〉
	第七章〈清朝的書院〉

專題(三)：宗教信仰與建築
台灣傳統佛教相當民間化，表現出與正信佛教非常殊異的特質。本課程將透過文獻的閱讀與田野的考察，除了釐清台灣傳統佛教與民間佛教建築的諸多面向與議題外，亦可訓練修課同學對於傳統社會佛教信仰的關照，對其所屬寺院庵堂之佛寺、齋堂、觀音廟、觀音亭，以及山邊的巖仔等建築類型進行研討；另外，民間信仰中清水祖師、普庵祖師、濟公信仰與佛教的關聯，都是可以探究的課題之一。
□佛教與民間信仰

description.zh: 本課程旨在提供學生解決跨文化管理問題所需的專業知識與行為技能。討論的議題包含文化複雜性、不同組織與個人的文化取向以及世界多種文化維度等面向。本課程鼓勵學生發展跨文化的溝通協調能力與管理技能，使學生在面對全球化組織中的管理問題時，可以從概念與行為上解決這些問題。
description.en: Organizations are becoming increasingly global. This course aims to provide the students with both the intellectual understanding and behavioral skills necessary to solve cross-culture management problems. The course addresses various issues related to the complexity of culture, the cultural orientation of different organizations and individuals, and the mapping of the world cultures dimensions. The course confronts the students with managerial problems in global organizations and requires the students to address these problems conceptually and behaviorally. Students are guided and encouraged to develop skills in cross-cultural communications, negotiation, and managing cultural differences in a multicultural environment, in order to effectively manage international businesses. Finally, students through various contemporary studies will be able to understand the cultural dynamics that are taking place around the globe

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在提供學生解決跨文化管理問題所需的專業知識與行為技能。討論的議題包含文化複雜性、不同組織與個人的文化取向以及世界多種文化維度等面向。本課程鼓勵學生發展跨文化的溝通協調能力與管理技能，使學生在面對全球化組織中的管理問題時，可以從概念與行為上解決這些問題。

description.zh: 隨著網路的迅速發展，電子商務更是也以每年20%成長率蓬勃發展，台灣預計將突破兆元的商機。在台灣下階段將邁入以生產力4.0作為科技發展的主軸，為因應同學畢業後的就業需求，本課程介紹電子商務的各種重點技巧，包括社群行銷與、行銷網站建置與管理、網路行銷工具、行銷資訊系統、網路外銷，Google管理工具的應用、關鍵字廣告、商業部落格、電子郵件與會員電子報廣告管理，行動行銷，網路行銷企劃案實務等重要議題，讓同學了解網路行銷及電子商務之實務運作。

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces the basic concepts, current development and practical operation of e-commerce from the perspectives of business and technology. Through case discussion, this course will discuss the implementation and management of e-commerce, such as website design, internet marketing, social networking sites, and business practice. This course will enhance the abilities of the students in e-commerce research and practical operation. The course content includes: 
1. Introduction of e-commerce
2. Internet marketing business model and strategy
3. Internet marketing website design and online business operation

syllabi.outline: This course introduces the evolution of e-commerce and its current status. The content will cover important topics of e-commerce development, including e-commerce business models, mobile commerce, application of artificial intelligence and big data techniques to e-commerce. Furthermore, some important theories in consumer behavior, organizational behavior, and information systems will be discussed. During the semester, the students will be able to understand the concepts and current situation of e-commerce, the impact of information technology that drives the development of e-commerce, the opportunities and challenges that modern companies face, and how to apply theories to improve customer experience in the e-commerce context, etc.

name.en: Security technology for Industrial Control System

description.zh:
本課程除了介紹工業物聯網技術及工控資安原理之外，更著重在檢測工具的實際操作使用，例如: packet sniffer等，並以國網中心所建置的CDX雲端資安攻防平台進行實作分析與演練，讓學生更了解技術原理的實際應用情境。課程內容包含：
●工業控制與智慧製造概論
●工業控制與智慧製造的威脅
●工業物聯網潛在威脅 
●工控系統通訊協定
●工業控制的資安風險評鑑
●工控資安
●工業控制系統開發安全標準
●工業控制系統組件安全檢測標準
description.en:
This course aims to introduce security technologies of industrial control system, and mainly focuses on practical operations on learning security detection tools, such as packet sniffer, etc. The course will use the CDX cloud platform for practical exercises.  Industrial security analysis and drills allow students to better understand the practical applications of security for industrial control systems. Course contents including:

●Introduction for industrial control & smart manufacturing
●Threats to industrial control & smart manufacturing
●Threats to industrial IoT
●Industrial control system communication protocols
●Industrial risk assessment
●Industrial control system security
●Security standards for industrial control systems
●Security testing standards for industrial components

name.en: Practices and applications of TRIZ innovative thinking

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。
description.en: The aim of this course is to show how to implement TRIZ to resolve conflicts in Product R&D, engineering, and management tactic in a innovative thinking manner. TRIZ has been well-known as a creative and innovative thinking theory in solving engineering and technology contradictions in the last two decades. However, few studies and practical usage were proposed in Product R&D, management area. Nearly 30 real cases are discussed to demonstrate the ideas guided by TRIZ in product R&D management, engineering technology, Project management, Service industry management, and Production management. This course is able to pre-train a lot of students creative way and solve contradiction for further applications in real career.

description.zh: 懸吊系統型式、彈簧、避震器、轉向系統介紹、輪胎定位、懸吊機構和轉向機構之運動幾何、懸吊系統和轉向系統之力量分析。
description.en: Types of Suspension System, Springs, Dampers, Introduction to Steering System, Wheel Alignment, Kinematic Geometry of Suspension and Steering Mechanisms, Force Analysis of Suspension and Steering Systems.

syllabi.outline:
這是一門和「車輛動力學」相關之應用性課程，主要係論述懸吊機構之幾何特徵如何影響車輛的動態行為。內容包括利用機構學之自由度分析歸納出所有懸吊系統的種類、利用瞬心法分析懸吊機構之幾何特徵和車輛轉向特性(轉向不足、轉向過度)的關係、及利用平面Closure Equation及空間Suspension Derivative等解析方式找出車身和輪胎之相對運動。
    接著利用靜力學的概念分析路面作用於輪胎上的力量(縱向力、轉彎力和荷重)如何藉由懸吊機構傳遞至車身，以及懸吊機構的設計對於輪胎荷重變化的影響等。最後則說明如何利用電腦輔助工程分析軟體(Adams-Car，華創、中華和國瑞汽車使用之軟體)進行懸吊系統的分析和改良設計 。

This course will help you organize and present your ideas in clear, fluent, logical paragraphs. Students will learn to analyze their own voice, style, and word choice with the goal of becoming more creative at the same time as they learn to write more clearly. We will workshop papers in small groups and as a class, helping students analyze their own and other students’ writing. Many weeks will also involve a review of important grammatical points.
syllabi.schedule:
Please see hard copy for the week-by-week assignments. Students will be working on narrative, persuasion, and argument in their writing assignments. Students will learn college-level and professional writing with the focus on ideas, clarity, maintaining interest, organization, professionalization, thorough and ethical research, citation, and tone.

Students will do peer reviews of one another's written work and are expected to make extensive revisions to each draft.
syllabi.assessment:
ASSIGNMENTS
•	In order to receive credit for this course, you must complete all assignments, drafts, and revisions. 
•	You are expected to make substantial revisions to each draft so that you can think about your issue as deeply and specifically as possible. 
•	All assignments are due in hard copy at the beginning of class. (You will have technology problems. Make sure to print your paper early enough that you will not run into difficulties with non-functioning printers.) For formal papers I take off 5% if you are late to class on a paper due date (10% if you are fifteen or more minutes late), 10% if the paper is turned in within twenty-four hours after the due date (4:00 p.m. on Wednesday) and 20% if the paper is turned in within forty-eight hours of the deadline (4:00 p.m. on Thursday). You will not receive any credit for a paper turned in more than 48 hours late. Late papers should be turned in both by an e-mail Word document (which must open if you wish to receive credit) and in an identical hard copy. (The e-mail lets me know at what time you turned in your paper. However, I only grade hard copies, and you must put the paper in my box as well.) I hope that you will turn in all papers on time [losing 10–20% can be dangerous, especially if the paper is just so-so rather than excellent], but in the event that a paper is late, bring it to my office. If I am not in my office, put the paper my box. Please also immediately send me an e-mail alerting me that you have left a paper for me. If you wish to receive credit for a late paper, it is your responsibility to make sure that the paper gets to me safely. 
•	In addition to the paper assignments, you will have informal writing exercises, grammar homework, quizzes, peer reviews, and presentations. Informal writing assignments, homework, and quizzes are not usually listed on the syllabus. 
•	No credit is given for late homework. If you will be absent, give me the assignment ahead of time.
•	Please bring a notebook with removable pages to every class period. Begin freewrites on a new page. (I sometimes collect them. I sometimes don’t.) 

REVISION AND WORKSHOPS

Be prepared to make multiple copies of drafts for peer review. You may take as many as three drafts home with you to read and comment on. We will then discuss these drafts in a workshop setting.  You will sometimes rate the usefulness of the comments received from other group members. Your ratings and my assessment of their comments will count towards their participation grade. During peer review, please give constructive criticism using the writing and editing techniques we will learn in this course. In order to receive participation and peer review points for each day, you will need to bring drafts that meet the assignment’s length requirements, to bring the correct number of copies of your draft, to fill out the peer-review sheets, and to stay on-task for the entire review session. 

PARTICIPATION

As your instructor, I am here to facilitate learning, to motivate and support you in your process of coming to terms with the language and culture of the college classroom. Your role as a student is to take responsibility for your learning by participating fully in class activities and discussions, peer groups, conferences, and assignments.

Since this is a discussion-based class, please be particularly attentive to those around you. I want you to feel free to speak up, and I also want our discussions to be productive. Know that thoughtful questions are quite as valuable as other kinds of participation. Use this class as an opportunity to work on your skills at engaging in interesting and productive conversations. You probably don’t think about this fact much, but working at making productive discussion contributions is a way of refining communication skills that will serve you well in interviews, jobs, and social situations.

This course is intended for university-level EFL writing students with the aim of increasing their fluency in English writing. To achieve this goal, students in this course read various kinds of articles and formulate their own critical thinking. With the experience of critical reading and thinking, students will develop their own writing strategies and write three short critical essays (500-800 words) with different rhetorical modes: comparison-contrast, cause-and-effect, and argumentative.

name.en: Product and Mixed Reality Design Research (1)

description.zh: 本課程將專注於創新產品與混合實境的設計研究方法，期望透過虛實整合與使用者經驗的核心概念，應用研究方法深入探究設計問題與使用者經驗中的痛點，探討實體端產品設計和虛擬端的服務設計之各種可能性與創新概念整合，進而透過設計方法與軟硬體技術落實創新概念，最終達到設計出符合與滿足使用者在未來生活中的各種設計服務與體驗。
description.en: This course will focus on the design research methods of innovative products and mixed reality. It is expected that through the core concepts of virtual-real integration and user experience, it will apply research methods to deeply explore design problems and pain points in user experience and explore physical product design and virtual reality. We will integrate various possibilities of service design with innovative concepts. Then, we intend to utilize the implemented innovative concept by design methods, software, and hardware technologies to achieve the design services and experiences that meet and satisfy users in future life.

description.zh: 光學元件、光學系統、精密機械元件、精密機械系統、光機系統之實務設計與個案研究
description.en: Optical elements, optical systems, elements of precision machinery, precision mechanical systems, optical machinery design and case study.

syllabi.outline:
光機系統應用極為廣泛，無論是天文、航太、軍事、醫療、半導體、加速器等高階系統，或講究快速與需價格競爭力之手機、車載、智慧監控等商品，皆仰賴札實的光學與機械知識以確立系統設計滿足需求。本課程內容特別挑選重要的光學與機械做解析外，搭配光學設計軟體、Matlab模擬以及應用實例以強化重要觀念，並使學生建立相關知解決工程問題與創新能力，並進一步確立興趣與發展方向為主要目標。
Optical mechanical systems have changed the world and they will continue to do so. The course of optical machinery designed practice aims to be a solution provider for high-end customers in astronomy, aerospace, military, accelerator, and medicine. Also the knowledge can satisfy mass production industries of mobile, automobile, and machine vision. To meet that need, not only does the course introduce core knowledge in optics and mechanics but also practice modeling and case studies to enhance the capability of problem solving and innovation. The subject makes possible to initiating students’ interest in the optical mechanical industry so as to make it as their future careers.
syllabi.schedule:
與下學期著重在動手實作並彙整光機知識，實習課程包括「運用幾何光學在成像系統」與「照明光學於非成像系統」的基本知識，在18周課程裡盡量涵蓋以下子單元：1. 理想系統，2. 現實像差系統，3. 鏡片及鏡面，4. 光學玻璃材料特性、5. 照度學、6.補充相關實例模擬與分析，7. 光學評價及光學檢測、8. 光學元件製造上的限制、9. 光學元件及系統的製圖、10. 光學系統的公差分析、11. 變焦鏡頭光學設計、12. 變焦鏡頭凸輪軌跡。為確保學生可學以致用，將輔導學生針對有興趣的專題於第17、18.週期末考繳交報告並上台(或線上)報告。
######
This semester will introduce and practice：1. ideal systems, 2. real systems, 3. optical and diffraction elements, 4. optical materials, 5. photometry and radiometry. Modeling and practice courses include 6. assessment of optical systems, 7. Zoom Lens principles 8. Zoom Lens Cam 9. Telescope Baffle design 10. tolerance analysis, 11. stray light analysis. 10. Final report and oral presentation.
syllabi.assessment: (1)課程參與40% (2)提問10%(3)期末報告20%(4)期末上台報告30%。class attendance (40%). question asking (10%). report (20%) and oral presentation(30%) for final.
syllabi.materials:
1. Malacara: Geometrical and Instrumental Optics, Academic Press 1988
2. Mahajan: Optical Imaging and Aberrations
3. Mouroulis/McDonald: Geometrical Optics and Optical Design Oxford 1997
4. WelfordAberrations of Optical Systems, Hilger 1986
5. Fischer/Tadic-GalebOptical System Design, McGraw Hill 2000
6. Kingslake/Johnson: Fundamentals of optical design
7. Smith: Modern Optical Engineering, Graw Hill 2000
8. Goodman: Introduction to Fourier Optics,Wiley 2005
9. lecture notes from University College London, University of Jena, University of Arizona, Imperial College London

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
國文，是運用本國語言文字，蘊釀於欣賞文藝作品，充實文化內涵，增進思維能力與人文素養的一門課程。
本課程分為大一上學期2學分，大一下學期2學分。大一上學期的授課內容，以文學名篇為範圍；希望藉此擴建學生深入品味文學趣味的能力，鍛鍊靈活的語文敏感度，默契文學創意，甚而嘗試創作。大一下學期的授課內容，以思想名篇為範圍；希望藉此啟發學生透轍分析各家學說思想，漫步哲人的宇宙天地，跟隨哲人的心路歷程，進而念茲在茲，從容內化，共饗取之不盡用之不竭的先驗與風範。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，培養學生邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.多項式，2.不等式及其應用，3.直角坐標及函數，4.三角函數及其應用，5.複數，6.平面之圓錐曲線，7.指數及對數函數，8.向量，9.矩陣，10.三度空間的基本觀念，11.數列與級數，12.排列組合與機率。
description.en: The course aims at: developing comprehension of algebra, trigonometry, analytical geometry, activating capabilities of logic inference and induction, enlightening confidence and independence, strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and graph, furnishing a sound basis for future specialty including Calculus. The content includes: 1.Polynomial, 2.Inequalities and its Application, 3.Rectangular Coordinate System and Functions, 4.Trigonometric Functions and its Application , 5.Complex Numbers, 6.Conic Section, 7. Exponential and Logarithmic Functions, 8.Vectors, 9.Matrix, 10.Elementary Concept of Three Dimensional Space, 11.Sequences and Series, 12.Permutation, Combination and Probability.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

name.en: Practice on Fabric Coating and Finishing

description.zh: 了解及熟悉各種布膜塗佈之技術, 每周實習以製作各種功能性布料為主. 布膜塗佈之技術包含(1)刮刀塗佈，(2)輪式塗佈，及(3)熔融輪壓塗佈(順塗，逆塗)等。功能性布料種類則包含吸汗，透氣，撥水，保溫，抗起球等各種性質。
description.en: To introduce various coating techniques which include (1) knife coating (2) gravure coating (3) hot melt coating (co-rotating and counter rotation). The functions built in the fabric includes (1) water absorption (2) water repellence (3) cooling (4) warm protection (5) anti peeling… etc..

To introduce various coating techniques which include (1) knife coating (2) gravure coating (3) hot melt coating (co-rotating and counter rotation). The functions built in the fabric includes (1) water absorption (2) water repellence (3) cooling (4) warm protection (5) anti peeling… etc..
syllabi.schedule:
第一堂 - 塗佈設備: 了解多功能塗佈設備之基本結構，以及塗佈工藝的基本原理。1.紙本資料及分組。
第二堂 - 材料準備與機台試車: 了解基本塗佈材料之特性，並實際運作設備以利熟悉。1. 紙本資料  2.機台操作示範試機。
第三堂 - 窗簾布: 單面撥水製做單面撥水基布，減少PU塗佈時的滲膠現象並保持較好的加工手感。1. T/C布， 2. 水性撥水劑配方-順向。

name.zh: 數位匯流與智財法律專題
name.en: Intellectual Property Laws in the Age of Digital Convergence

description.zh: 在數位匯流的趨勢下，網際網路不但即將成為各種傳統媒體的聚集之處，同時也不斷衍生新型態的媒體傳播方式。有鑑於此，本課程目的即在探討數位匯流時代的智財法律議題。將由實際案例為主，輔以相關分析文章及法律規定的解析，帶領同學了解數位環境的特性、數位媒體形式與媒體內容的發展，同時針對著作權、隱私權等實用智慧財產權議題，讓同學了解、並具備分析數位時代的媒體趨勢、以及智財法律策略的能力。
description.en: In the face of digital convergence, the internet seems will not only become the ultimate channel for all kinds of traditional media, but the birthplace of new types. In light of the challenges posed by the digital age, this course is aimed at helping students explore the IP legal issues with reference to the media evolution on the internet. It will begin with the introduction of the characteristics of the internet, the developments of the digital media formation and content, and followed by the discussions and analysis on the cases in the real life.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 資料科學為最熱門的職業之一，各行各業對於數據分析的人才需求正在蓬勃發展，本課程在於培育從事資料科學或機器學習的人員來發展相關知識和技能。課程內容以線性代數、機率、統計學等工程數學為理論學習基礎，操作Python作為資料科學的實作工具，包括其相關Python基礎語法、各種資料型態、數據 可視化、開源工具等。接著學習利用Python取得數據資料，進而操作各種迴歸 分析來手動分析數據資料，並實作梯度遞減，決策樹等最佳化演算方法。最後則是介紹機器學習、深度學習等最新的AI演算方法來分析大數據並輔助決策。
description.en: Data Science has been ranked as one of the hottest professions and the demand for data practitioners is booming. This course is designed to develop people engaged in data science or machine learning to develop relevant knowledge and skills. You will understand how data science works based on mathematics, such as linear algebra, probability and statistics. Python is the best tool to learn how to conduct data science analyze data. Learn the basic language skills, common data types, visualization tools and extended modules for data grabbing and regression analysis. Gradient decent and decision tree for optimization will be covered. Finally, AI algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning, are introduced how data help in decision making.

syllabi.outline: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for decision-making supports in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which include: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business analytics, and data analytic project. The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic is used to add value to a business, etc. Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(flexible working hours and 32 hours at least per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

syllabi.outline:

The semiconductor industry has recently become one of the most important industries. This course covers the basic knowledge, processes and recent development trend of semiconductors, and features a group of known scholars and experts as keynote speakers to talk about the semiconductor sector. The topics include semiconductor materials, organic semiconductors, sensors, device applications, energy and panels, etc., in order for students to further understand the basics and applications of semiconductors.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子製造程序（其中最主要者為積體電路之製造程序）。首先說明製造方法上之三個 主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。
description.en: An introduction to the semiconductor manufacturing process. Courses include diffusion, microlithography and deposition.

syllabi.outline:
半導體電路是近年來成為人工智慧與互聯網中提供第一手資料最重要的一個環節，本課程涵蓋了基於各種半導體感測器的基礎知識(如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技)以及訊號分析，同時也將結合Arduino電路實驗以及分組討論，來協助學子進一步了解感測器電路的實際應用。
Semiconductor circuits have recently become the most important part of providing first-hand information in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). This course covers the fundamentals of various semiconductor sensors (e.g. chemical modification, electrochemistry, optics and semiconductor technology) and signal analysis, and involves Arduino circuit experiments with group discussions, in order for students to further understand the practical applications of sensor circuits.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.en: The Diversified English Series aims to develop students’ English communication competence through a variety of English courses. These courses integrate training of language skills, content-driven instruction and pragmatic use of English by tasks. The design of the series of courses incorporates the following syllabi: the collaborative task-based syllabus, content-based syllabus, and interactive skill-based syllabus, encompassing a wide range of topics. Selecting the best possible course is a key decision to guarantee the success of English learning. It is thus recommended that students evaluate their needs and wants and discuss the course options available with their English instructors.

description.en: This course addresses the concepts and principles of Big Data and how Big Data can be used in the Enterprise. The course provides an overview of the fundamental principles of Big Data Analytics and its role in making better decisions and predictions in the organization. The course also covers the Technology, Infrastructure and Applications of Big Data. Concepts of data identification, data cleansing and integration are also addressed. Software and Application requirements of Big Data are addressed and case studies of Big Data Applications are discussed.

name.en: Elective  Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Culture

description.zh: 本課程旨在提昇學生的人文素養。透過文學概論、藝術概論與文化概論等相關課程，引導學生探索文學的妙趣，欣賞藝術的美質，瞭解文化的傳統。從古典到現代，從本土到世界，從物質到心靈，建構多元化的文化視野。以臺灣為出發點，搜尋未知的世界地圖，找到人們必然駐足的角落，以及自己不可缺席的人文風景。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to enrich the literary taste and the cultural cultivation of our students. Though the related course, like Introduction of Literature, Introduction of Art and Introduction of Culture, we hope to guide the students to explore the interest of the Literature, to enjoy the beauty of the Art and to understand the tradition of the Culture. From classic to modern, from local to universe, from material to spirit, we want to construct multiple cultural views. Taking Taiwan as a start, we would search the unknown map of the universe, and would find a corner for consequential staying and one's own liberal scenery.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

name.en: Elective  Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：Philosophy

description.zh: 哲學既是一門兼具理想性與現實性的基礎學科，又是一種既有趣又深刻的一種思想活動。 它所探討的目標都是和人類自身與他們所生活的周遭世界密切相關的一些基本問題；這些基本問題至少包括：宇宙、知識、公平正義、道德、宗教、語言、心靈、社會、教育、愛情，和生與死。 從事哲學思考，就是對上述問題，進行一種反省。 這種反省，能夠讓我們明白形成這些問題背後的一些基本原則，以及解決這些問題的一些可能方案的理由根據和獲致這些解決方案的應有程序。 由於哲學是著重思考與反省的活動，學習哲學其實不僅僅可以幫助我們掌握和人類自身與生活世界相關問題的一些根本知識，更能培養一個負責任的社會公民不可或缺的一種思維能力和反省態度。
description.en: Philosophy is not only a fundamental subject with both ideals and practical value, but also an interesting thinking activity of depth.  The topics it discusses concern some basic questions for we human beings and the world around us.  These basic questions at least include: the universe, knowledge, equality and justice, morality, religion, language, mind, society, education, love, and life and death.  Thinking things philosophically is to reflect upon these basic questions.  The reflection of this sort leads us to understand not only the basic principles behind these questions,   also the reasons and procedures of the possible solutions to these questions.  Given philosophy is such an activity based on thinking and reflection, learning philosophy hence can help us grasp the required knowledge concerning ourselves and our living world, and more importantly, prepare a thinking ability and reflecting attitude that are needed for us to succeed in becoming responsible social citizen.

name.en: Elective Curriculum of Liberal Arts Education：History

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生對歷史這門學科有一通盤、系統的認識，以便讓學生瞭解歷史的思維取向，增加個人的歷史意識。並在歷史學門的領域中，提供數門基礎及進階課程，供同學選修，以期同學從課程的學習中，理解台灣、中國乃至世界文明的進程與發展，剖析歷史學與現實的互動，提昇學生批判思考之能力。
description.en: This course focuses on getting the students familiar with the academic field of history in a more comprehensive and systematic view. The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some  courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

The students are stimulated to think and make judgment with a view to "knowing the history," adding to a better sense of history. Further, they are guided to select some  courses in the field of history, including the formation and changes of the of Taiwan China and the World-as well as interactions between history and the reality-thus enhancing their critical ability to think and judge.

description.zh: 本課程在介紹如何運用企業內與員工之有關資源，包括其能力、知識、技術、態度和激勵，以配合企業整體競爭策略與形式。其內容有：人力資源分析、策略及目標、支援性作業之取得、發展及報酬、人力資源的維護。
description.en: This course introduce how to apply the resource of the inter-corporation and employee, such as capacity, knowledge, technology, attitude and incentive, in order to cooperate business integrate competitive strategy.

description.zh: 國際商務市場行銷管理。包括在國際環境中的市場研究、定價、促銷和分銷。審查市場的問題出現不同程度的外資參與（出口，許可證，外國分公司）。先修課程：MARK5311市場行銷。
description.en: Management of marketing in international business. Includes marketing research, pricing, promotion, and distribution in the international environment. Examines marketing problems arising from various degrees of foreign involvement (exports, licensing, foreign subsidiaries). Prerequisite: MARK 5311 (MARKETING).

description.zh:
戰略管理使用綜合管理視角去解決相關的制定和實施企業和企業級戰略的問題。
該課程包括開發識別問題的能力，評估戰略選擇，並瞭解戰略的形成和執行的組織過程。它建立在功能區課程所獲得的知識，並使用案例研究和項目，以提高學生的分析和決策能力。前提：必須參與上學期的課程或與得到研究生導師的許可。
description.en: Strategic management uses a general management perspective in addressing issues related to the formulation and implementation of corporate and business level strategy. The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 課程目標在教授學生生醫材料與醫療器材技術商品化之實務知識。首先介紹生醫材料產品之特性與市場概況，並由各國醫療法規為出發點，教導學生了解生醫材料產品上市所需之相關程序。特別透過實例之講解，引導學生了解設計、製造、測試三大重點之實務操作。包括產品設計之準則，ISO 13485醫療器材品質系統實務操作，臨床前生物相容測試以及臨床試驗之執行等。課程設計將著重實際法規之講解、實力講解與分析以工廠參觀。將由本校專任教師配合企業講師任教，培育學生迅速進入相關產業工作之能力。
description.en: The objective of this course it to illustrate the commercialization process for biomaterials products. The features and the marketing overview of biomaterials will be introduced first. The regulatory issues and the necessary procedures for the commercialization process will be introduced. By the case studies, it is designed to train the students about the necessary concepts of product design, manufacturing and testing processes. It consists of the product design guidelines, ISO 13485 medical products GMP, pre-clinical and clinical tests.

description.zh: 本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程 式進行工廠 CPS 產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與 品管，並實務教導開發 AI 瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控 PLC 達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。
description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

syllabi.outline:
工業4.0智能工廠因為大量使用電腦資訊流進行智慧控制達到產線無人化境地，雲端資料庫技術是智能工廠的核心技術，從智慧排單到網頁控制，達到智能聯網與控制。本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠連線。
Industry 4.0 intelligent factory because of the heavy use of computer information flow for intelligent control to achieve the production line unmanned situation, cloud database technology is the core technology of intelligent factory, from smart single to web control, to achieve intelligent networking and control. This course to the landing industry application technology-based, imported into the German University of Technology task-oriented learning model, the course teaches students from the construction of a cloud database server to write a three-machine integrated web control program for factory CPS production and marketing information management system, series factory man-machine materials and production lines and quality control, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, factory-wide factory connection.

description.zh:
近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。
大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響
本課程，將向同學生講解社會責任基本觀念，以介紹學社會責任的理念構想與實踐經驗，並移地教學，地方場域問題作為主題報告討論素材等方式，來增強學生進行社會創新的態度、認知和行為。
description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

syllabi.schedule:
本課程為配合教育部教學實踐研究計畫(陳建文主持，當我們同在一起：《團隊導向學習教學法（TBL)》運用於通識教育USR特色課程之研究教育部教學實踐研究計畫(計畫編號：PSR1100752)，研究期程:2021.08.01-2022.07.30)所開設之USR特色課程。修課學生需同意參與前述教學實踐研究計畫。

   本課程以3天2夜移地USR場域之密集式現地學習活動為核心，分三階段進行課程，非採每週固定時間授課三個階段之授課之主題､內容､時數與進度說明如下:

第1階段:在校授課
課程主題為:移地USR場域密集式現地學習活動之準備訓練與活動籌備
每週2小時授課，計3週6小時，其教學內容為:
1.研討場域議題文獻，讓學生形成背景瞭解，主題包括(1)桃園市復興區作物的過去現在與未來(2)桃園市復興區蔬菜運用冷藏問題的創新思考(3)桃園市復興區國小特色課程的創新思考(4)桃園市復興區竹林資源運用的創新思考。
2.田野調查技巧訓練講座，學習田野調查技巧以及注意事項
3.引導學生討論籌畫3天2夜移地USR場域密集式現地學習活動

name.en: Internship of practical technology research and development

description.zh: 本課程之目的為讓技術導向博士班學生於學期間至本所各分組專業相關之企業、政府單位或具規模之其他機構從事全職實務技術研發工作，讓技術導向博士生除發展學術理論外，更擁有業界實務經驗，以成為學養精湛且具有實務技能之高階專業人才。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the technique-orientated Ph.D. students . During the semester, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry / business-oriented agencies working as a full-time R & D practical job. Course takers are in addition to developing technology-oriented doctoral level academic theory, but also has practical experience in the industry, to become a highly specialized personnel with practical professional skills.

name.zh: 老化與體適能專題研究
藝文產業企劃與經營專題
文化創意產業專題研究
司馬遷至劉知幾史學的發展

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授並彙交所屬系所保存。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on-site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

name.zh: 彈性工時學期校外實習

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，工時可彈性安排週間但每週不得低於32小時。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(flexible working hours and 32 hours at least per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用學期間至相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業企業之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation in one of the corporative company during curriculum session, practice and learn the real operation of the ing related fields . A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期到工業工程與管理相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the industrial engineering and management related fields in one of the corporative industrial engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative industrial engineering and management company full-time at least 4.5 months.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
